description.zh:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括五大項：
一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換，   特殊函數。
二 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
五 複變分析及映射轉換。
description.en:
This course intends to inbtroduce the mathematical principles and practices that today's engineers need to know. The course contents are 
1. Ordinary Differential Eqs: 1st order, 2nd order and higher    order ODEs. Laplace transform, special function.
2. Vector Algebra and Vector Analysis: Matrixs and    Determinants, Eigenvalve problems.
3. Fourier Series, Integral and Transforms.
4. Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value    Problems.
5. Complex Analysis: complex Integration, conformal mapping    and Applications.

二 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。

description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

syllabi.outline:
	課程名稱：電路學(上)
	介紹：集總電路和克希荷夫定律（KCL, KVL），電路元件，串、並聯電路，一階電路，二階電路，線性非時變電路分析，相量及弦波穩態分析，耦合元件和電路，多相電路，複數頻率，頻率響應，狀態變數法，雙埠網路，PSPICE，傅式分析及轉換，拉式轉換。
	說明：本課程的目標是培養未畢業的學生建立電路理論基礎。為此，學習了電路的概念和分析技術，增強了解決電路問題的相關電磁理論、物理概念和數學方法。研究了包括解析法和數值法在內的逼近方法。 學生可以從中了解許多電路定理及其應用和一些相關的方法軟件。 除了電路分析技術外，鼓勵學生解決一些簡單的電路綜合問題，以便將來進一步研究電路設計及其相關領域。
	Course Title: Electric Circuits
	Description: Lumped circuit and Kirchhoff's law (KCL, KVL), circuit components, series and parallel circuits, first-order circuits, second-order circuits, linear time-invariant circuit analysis, phasor and sine wave steady-state analysis, coupling components and Circuit, multiphase circuit, complex frequency, frequency response, state variable method, dual port network, PSPICE, Fourier analysis and conversion, pull conversion.
	Explanation: The goals of this course are to discipline the students of under graduated level to erect their fundamental on the circuit theory. For this, the concepts and the analysis technique of electric circuit are learned, in which the related electromagnetic theory, physical concepts and mathematic methods for solving the circuit problems will be enhanced. The students can realize many circuit theorems and their applications and some associated approach software. In addition to the circuit analysis techniques, the students are encouraged to solve some simple circuit synthesis problems for further study on the circuit design and its related fields in the future.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.en:
This course intends to inbtroduce the mathematical principles and practices that today's engineers need to know. The course contents are 
1. Ordinary Differential Eqs: 1st order, 2nd order and higher    order ODEs. Laplace transform, special function.
2. Vector Algebra and Vector Analysis: Matrixs and    Determinants, Eigenvalve problems.
3. Fourier Series, Integral and Transforms.
4. Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value    Problems.
5. Complex Analysis: complex Integration, conformal mapping    and Applications.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction, Terminology and Separable Equations
第1週  課程介紹；微分方程用語與可分離方程式
Week 2 The Linear First-Order Equation, Exact Equations
第2週  一階線性微分方程式、正合方程式
Week 3 Integrating Factors, Homogeneous Equations
第3週  積分因子法、齊性微分方程式
Week 4 Bernoulli and Riccati Equations, Additional Applications
第4週  伯努利方程式及雷卡迪方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 5 The Linear Second-Order Equation, Reduction of Order
第5週  二階線性微分方程式、降階法
Week 6 The Constant Coefficient Homogeneous Equation
第6週  常係數齊性微分方程式
Week 7 Particular Solutions of the Nonhomogeneous Equation
第7週  非齊性微分方程式的特解
Week 8 The Euler Differential Equation, Additional Applications
第8週  尤拉微分方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 9 High Order Differential Equations, Midterm Exam.
第9週  高階微分方程式、期中考
Week 10 Definition and Notation of Laplace Transform
第10週 拉氏轉換式的定義與標號
Week 11 Solution of Initial Value Problems, Shifting Theorem and the Heaviside Function
第11週 含有初值問題的解、移位定理與赫維賽德函數
Week 12 Convolution, Impulses and the Dirac Delta Function
第12週 摺積、單位脈衝及狄拉克德爾塔函數
Week 13 Solution of Systems of Laplace Transform
第13週 線性微分方程式系統的解
Week 14 Polynomial Coefficients Differential Equations
第14週 多項式係數的拉氏轉換式
Week 15 Power Series Solutions
第15週 冪級數的解
Week 16 Frobenius Solutions and the real roots
第16週 弗羅貝尼斯的解與實根
Week 17 Frobenius Solutions with k≠0
第17週 具有k≠0弗羅貝尼斯的解
Week 18 Final Exam.
第18週  期末考

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 介紹化工程序中物質於一系統中流進、流出間質量、能量均衡之原理與計算，使學生學習列出質能均衡之基本式子並查尋相關文獻，手冊上所登錄之物性資料以解決問題。
description.en: The course introduces the material and energy balances of the chemical process.  Students learn to define the system, practice the conservation law of mass and energy, and look up handbook for necessary information.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹化學工程程序中物質於一系統中流進、流出間質量、能量均衡之原理與計算，主要銜接化學專業與工廠內化工製程操作，因化工廠內工作人員被要求對「參與化學反應的質量關係，以及反應中能量的去除或加入」必需清楚明瞭，熟讀本科可擁有足夠的化學專業知識，故可「以最經濟的化學反應成本來量產高附加物品，獲取最大的益」。使學生學習列出質能均衡之基本式並查尋研讀相關文獻、與手冊上所登錄之物性資料以解決各種相關問題。
1.瞭解化學工廠中質量與能量變化之相關知識
2.瞭解化學專業應用在工廠操作之產程放大技術與考量
3.瞭解化學產業之市場動態及其發展情形

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline:
以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括氣體動力論、熱力學、物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、反應動力學、輸送性質等。

本課程為兩學期的課程，在第一學期的部分，將主要集中於熱力學的部分，內容將會包含物質的狀態方程、熱力學三大定律的概念建構、以及相變化的熱力學描述。

相關會處理的議題將會包括：理想氣體與真實氣體的差異性、能量的概念、「亂度」的定義、自由能作為判定程序自發性的標準等等。
syllabi.schedule:
1. The properties of gases 
氣體的性質。內容包含理想氣體、氣體動力論、真實氣體、van der Waals狀態方程的討論。

2. The First Law of Thermodynamics
熱力學第一定律。內容將包含功、熱、焓、狀態方程的概念討論。

3.The Second and Third Laws
熱力學二、三定律。內容將包含對於「亂度」(entropy)、吉布司自由能、Maxwell關聯式等概念的討論。

4. Physical transformations of pure substances
將應用所教授的熱力學三大定律的內容，對純物質的相變化系統進行討論。

5. Simple mixtures
混合物的熱力學討論、將涵蓋理想氣體混合過程、partial molar properties的定義。

*將會在第1、2部分教授完時進行期中考試以測驗學生的理解，期末考的部分將涵蓋第3~5點內容。

description.zh: 訓練學生以實驗技巧，探討理論，認識儀器，並對實驗結果之數據與現象做評析與處理。

syllabi.schedule:
一 固體密度的測定 藉比重瓶測定粒狀或粉狀等不規則形固體的密度
二 液體密度的測定 藉漢埃氏法測定液體或溶液的密度
三 表面張力的測定 藉毛細管上升法測定不同溫度下液體的表面張力
四 液體黏度的測定 以奧士瓦黏度計測定純液體或溶液於各種溫度時之相對黏度，並了解相對黏度及絕對黏度的定義及測定法
五 凝固點下降法測定分子量 依據Clausius-Clapeyron方程式及稀薄溶液理論，藉貝克曼凝固點下降分子量測定裝置，以圖解法求溶質之真正分子量
六 中和熱的測定 藉由量熱器測定各種酸與鹼溶液的中和熱，並熟悉量熱器水當量的測定法
七 液體蒸氣壓的測定 藉等壓管法測定液體蒸氣壓，並與Clausius-Clapeyron方程式相驗證，進而估算液體的汽化熱
八 固體溶質溶解度的測定 了解溶解度的定義及其測定方法，以測定固體溶質在不同溫度下的溶解度並求該物質的溶解熱
九 溶質於相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率 測定溶質在相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率，並依據熱力學原理，由分配律測求其會合度或解離度
十 二成份系之液液平衡 測定水-酚系溶液之溶解度曲線（成份與溫度的關係），並求其臨界溶解溫度（或稱會溶溫度）及其組成

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程介紹用於解析實際工程問題所需之相關數學方法 ,其內容包括：常微分方程式、線性常微分方程式、拉普拉氏轉換、級數及傅立葉級數、線性代數及矩陣、以及積分定理。
description.en: This course introduces engineering students the mathematics in practical engineering problems. The topics covered include: ordinary differential equations, linear ordinary differential equations, Laplace transforms, series and Fourier series, linear algebra, matrix, and integration theorems.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要目標在介紹與實際問題相關之數學領域，以模擬解題及詮釋等方式，將數學方法應用在工程問題上。課程內容有常微分方程，線性代數，向量微積分，Fourier 分析及偏微分方程式等章節，訓練同學在理論，計算及實驗間建立正確的認知及意義。內容將繼續介紹複數分析及數值方法等章節，尤其對計算機的概念及演算法乃給予較多的強調，對實際問題亦有簡化討論。另外，在應用解決問題構想，練習例題及理論間，更有相輔相成的效果。至於線性規化，圖形組合，機率理論及數學機率等內容亦有概略介紹，務使同學有正確的認知。
syllabi.schedule: 第一週複習微積分之基本概念與公式及各種積分技巧，第二週一階線性常微分方程式(ODE)之變數分離、齊次與非齊次、常係數與變係數，第三週正合微分方程式與積分因子法，第四週白努力方程式與Racatti方程式與一階高次非齊次ODE(第一次小考)，第五週二階線性ODE之重疊原理與通解(General Solution)與二階常係數齊次與非齊次ODE，第六週高階線性ODE與ODE系統介紹，第七週幕級數與ODE之級數解(第二次小考)，第八週Legendre Equation與Bessel Equation，第九週Sturm-Liouville問題與正交函數，第十週拉普拉斯(Laplace)轉換與逆轉換、S平移與導數及積分之轉換，第十一週單位步階函數(USF)與t平移，第十二週短脈衝、Dirac's Delta、部分分式之轉換(第五次小考)(第三次小考)，第十三週摺積(Convolution)原理與應用，第十四週矩陣乘法與線性方程式組(LES)，第十五週特徵值(Eigenvalues)與特徵向量(Eigenvectors)、相似矩陣與對角化矩陣，第十六週行列式特性與克拉瑪法則，第十七週向量微分：梯度、旋度與散度，第十八週期末總複習(第四次小考)。

description.zh: 配合顯微組織學課程，使學生從實際顯微組織觀察中，依據相圖的理論觀念，分析和判斷材料的基本特徵。藉由應用顯微鏡設備，結合試片製作與處理的技術，從事試片構造的觀察，據此作為熱處理物件之分析，塑性加工或鑄件之研判，是為本課程的訓練目的。實習內容含括影片教學，熱電偶之測定與應用，熱分析法、以及試片的製作與處理等實作練習。

description.zh: 將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。
description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy and its equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solution thermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change, computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning a mathmatics model of metallurgy.

syllabi.outline:
This course applies the theories of thermodynamics to evaluate the chemical potentials equilibrium phases. Three fundamental laws of thermodynamics will first be introduced.  The effects of temperature and pressure upon Gibbs Free energy are then discussed. Applications for solutions, phase diagram, and chemical reaction evaluations with aids of computers will be the main practical topics for thermodynamics. The concepts of thermodynamics will be used extensively for metallurgical and materials-related fields.

本課程討論材料熱力學的基本理論、技巧及應用等，特別是平衡時化學熱力學有關氣相，氣体定理，熱量，功，熱力學第一、第二及第三定律，溫度與壓力對焓，熵，自由能之影響等概念；利用電腦輔助計算溶液、相圖與相平衡、及化學反應平衡等均為熱力學的應用範疇，這些概念對於諸多冶金、材料相關的場域皆十分重要。

description.zh:
材料之特性取決於材料內部組織，所以課程內容也注重內部組織與材料特性之間的關係，內部組織的變化對材料特性之影響，由理論為基礎之探討至實際之應用上。對本課程有關的基本概念，則詳加說明，初學材料者能得到材料上所必備之基本知識，若基本概念已有充分了解，則利用這些知識即可參考材料規格或手冊就可得到欲知之條件，進而以此概念作基礎，亦可研習更高深之學問，本課程內容著重於介紹材料之結構，基本原理有： 1. 金屬之基本理論，金屬及合金之構造，材料之組織，塑性加工變形之理論，材料之物理化學，機械性質及其實驗。 2. 鋼和鐵之製造，組織及其熱處理，變態理論。 3. 構造用鋼，合金鋼，工具鋼，特殊鋼之特性、用
途及其熱處理方法。4. 鋼之表面硬化理論及其熱處理方法。 5. 鑄鐵之冶煉，種類及其熱處理方法。6.非鐵金屬材料，銅，鋁，鈦，鎂，錫，鋅，鉛，鎳等合金種類之特性及其處理方法。

description.zh: 專業技術不斷開創與努力，如果再配合管理經營的能力，即能相得益彰，成就非凡。工廠管理是用來探討經營或管理工廠的方法，即以工廠管理人員的立場，研究如何應用最有效的方法，來組合應用各項生產要素，以獲得工廠經營的目標。目前工業發展情況，政府的工業措施與方案，以及我國文化背景，都必須與工廠管理的方法結合，才能成為最佳的經營者。
description.en: It would be an extraordinary achievement if an endless creative professional skill can be matched with excellent management ability. This course is used to discuss the method of management or administration, that is to make a research in using the most effective approach to combine all the necessary production elements from the viewpoint of factory management class, so that the management objective can be reached. The current industry development, the initiative and policy of industry, and the culture background of this country all have to be matched with factory management strategy, thus, would become the best management once and for all.

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹最新的製造技術。利用物理式及化學式的製造方法來加工新進材料，使用新進光電能源及新進製造工具如雷射、鑽石、電子束、離子束、電漿、化學反應劑等，適應生產微小精密工件之需求，由冶金技術製造的材料與產品包括：高熔點材料、超硬質材料、超耐熱材料、燒結機械另件、燒結摩擦材料、燒結磁性材料等，以期讓學過冶金課程的學生，能進一步對製造技術之應用有更多的了解。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 課程主要目標，是要使工程科系，發展出以簡單而合於邏輯的方式分析任何問題，並應用一些為大家熟悉的基本原理加以解答。本課程內容分成質點力學及剛體力學兩部分，剛體力學部分又分為靜力學及動力學。除介紹力學中的基本觀念及定理外更解釋及預測各種物理現象，進而打好工程應用的基礎。提供同學分析及設計各種機件和承載荷重結構的方法，課程內容將介紹某些依據基本定理而化簡的數學模式，進而分析及設計作用在結構上的各種條件，使同學在選擇或運用材料上有安全與正確的觀念，以便在理論與經驗的配合下，順利地處理材料在工程上所發生的問題。
description.en: The major target of this course is to let the engineering students develop and analyze any questions with an easy and logical way, and to try to solve them with some well-recognized fundamental principles. The course can be divided into particle dynamics and rigid body dynamics, the latter can be further divided into statics and dynamics. Apart from introducing the fundamental concept and law, it also explains and forecasts all kinds of nature physic phenomenon, in order to establish a good foundation for engineering application science. It provides methods for students to analyze and design all kinds of machine elements, bearing load structure as well, the course content will introduce some implified math models which are based on fundamental principles, and further analyze and design all conditions to the structure , let students have a safe and exact concept in choosing and utilizing materials, so that the theory and experience can be well matched, and the problems arisen from hand.

syllabi.outline: 本課程歷經幾屆學生的反應與討論, 老師最終將大二上學期的應用力學與下學期的材料力學, 從原本偏向機械系與土木系的靜力學/材料力學, 轉為以物理系的統計力學以及材料系的熱力學為主的(材料特色)應用力學, 我們會從機械系的引擎(熱機)出發, 進入熱力學第二定律, 最終將物理系的統計(熱)力學中的排列方法數(微觀態)與材料(熱)力學中的熵(巨視態)結合成一套連貫性知識
syllabi.schedule:

課程內容大致分為以下幾部分:
1. 熱機
2. 熱機的效率
3. 巨視性質
4. 熱力學第二定律
5. 統計力學

description.en: This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts. Syntax and semantics of the VB and C (or JAVA) programming languages will be introduced. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python語言為基礎，在Python包索引（PyPI中）的主機中，擁有成千上萬的Python模組。本課程內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
syllabi.schedule:
Ｗeek 1-2 運算思維與程式設計 - 跨入程式設計的大門
程式設計，是針對電腦要解決的問題提供處理方式的過程，也是軟體開發時的重要步驟。Python是一個執行功能強大，但語法簡潔優雅的程式語言，不僅容易學習，更容易應用實作在許多專題上！

Ｗeek 3-5 變數與運算式 - 不只先乘除後加減
變數建立時，應用程式就會配置一塊記憶體，並以變數名稱做為辨識此塊記憶體的標誌，設計者就可在程式中將各種資料存入使用。運算式包含了運算元與運算子，可以進行程式的運算動作。
‧本章範例包括：成績單、稅率報表及薪資表格式化輸出\梯形、長方形面積計算\複利本金計算...等。

Week 6-8 判斷式 - 邏輯思維的起點
程式設計也和日常生活雷同，常會遇到一些需要做決策的情況，再依決策結果執行不同的程式碼，這就是「判斷式」。
‧本章範例包括：密碼比對判斷\輸入成績評等\電影分級判斷\百貨公司折扣戰\數字比大小...等。

Week 9 期中上機檢核

Week 10-11 迴圈 - 翻滾吧！程式碼
電腦最擅長處理的工作就是重複執行的事情，而日常生活中到處充斥著這種不斷重複的現象，程式專門用來處理重複事件的命令稱為「迴圈」。
‧本章範例包括：建立數列\計算正整數總和\井字直角三角形\九九乘法表\找最小公倍數\階乘計算...等。

Week 12-14  串列與元組 - 大量數據收納術
串列又稱為清單或列表，與其他語言的陣列相同，其功能與變數相類似，是提供儲存資料的記憶體空間。元組的結構與串列完全相同，不同處在於元組的元素個數及元素值皆不能改變。
‧本章範例包括：串列初值設定\迴圈讀取串列\成績計算\刪除串列元素\成績排序...等。

Week 15  字典 - 為資料貼上標籤
字典資料型態，其元素是以「鍵-值」對方式儲存，運作方式為利用「鍵」來取得「值」。‧本章範例包括：血型個性查詢\四季天氣查詢\成績查詢\產品銷售查詢\世大運獎牌數查詢...等。

Week 16 函式與模組 - 簡化運算擴充功能的利器
在程式中通常會將具有特定功能或經常重複使用的程式，撰寫成獨立的小單元，稱為函式。Python擁有許多模組，可讓功能可以無限擴充。
‧本章範例包括：攝氏華氏溫度\公斤英磅轉換\均分蘋果\電費、家庭支出查詢\網址格式檢查\檔案格式檢查\成績單、業績報表列印\日期時間格式轉換\擲骰子遊戲\大樂透抽獎\四星彩開獎...等。

Week 17  演算法：排序與搜尋 - 用邏輯來解決問題
演算法就是為了解決一個問題而採取的方法和步驟，通常會以虛擬碼來表示，再以熟悉的語言來實現。‧本章範例包括：數字排排站\追蹤泡沫排序\搜尋中獎者\彩券對獎...等。

Week 18 期末上機檢核

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

5. 本學期課程以常微分方程為主

description.zh:
為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解設計圖中內容，本課程採用實務的教學方式，以工程師實際面對的建築設計圖、結構設計圖、土木設計圖及機電設計圖等，加以解說圖面內容並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下:
1.熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容
2.熟悉設計圖上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義
3.結構標準圖、配筋圖與施工規範之解說
4.如何依設計圖進行工程品質之查驗
5.其他與勞工安全相關知識等
description.en:
To improve undergraduate civil engineering students to understand the design drawings reading ability.  This course provides a set of design drawings, such as building, structural, civil and MEP design drawings, for instructors to explain the meaning of the design drawing, and guide the students to read the related drawings. The course also includes practical exercise for students to read the drawings, and to understand the information in the drawings. The course will also involves the knowledge of engineering to enhance the integration ability of all the design drawings for the students. The contents of this  course are listed as below:
1.To familiar with the whole set design drawings.
2.To familiar with the meaning of symbols, lines and expression in the design drawings.
3.To understand general notes, general drawings, reinforcement and specification in structural design drawings.
4.How to inspect the construction quality by the design drawings.
5.Other topics about labor-safety

syllabi.outline:
為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解建築工程中設計圖、結構圖、施工圖說及營造工程施工圖說之內容與應用。本課程採用實務的教學方式，以營造工程師實際面對的建築設計圖說、結構設計圖說及機電設計圖說...等內容。加以解說圖面內容，並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下: 
1.熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容。 
2.熟悉施工圖說上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義。 
3.結構構造之標準圖、配筋圖、鋼構...與施工規範之解說。
4.BIM基本建置原則與實務管理模型知識。 
5.如何依設計圖說進行工程品質之查驗。 
6.其他與工程實務所需之知識與技能、施工、構造、勞工安全...等，相關法令知識與其專業領域結合。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程旨在教導學生具備獨立思考有機化學的能力;因此課程分為基本觀念(結構式與鍵結),有機化學反應與反應機構以及化合物的製備與分析等三大部分。
description.en: The aim of this course is to educate students to think independently about organic chemistry. The course is divided into three parts;introductory material(concepts of structure and bonding);organic reactions and mechanism(sigma-bond chemistry followed by  pi-bond chemistry);and topics of more specialized interest.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋兩部分：(1)介紹一階常微分方程式，二階與高階的線性微分方程式，包含物理問題或是其他問題導出微分方程式，以實際重要性的簡單方法求解答。(2)線性代數，矩陣、向量、行列式、線性方程式組，應用於電路與力學之最佳化計算過程。
description.en: This course includes two main parts: (1) Introduction of first-order ordinary differential equations, second-order and higher-order linear differential equations, including physics problems or other problems to derive differential equations, and solve them in a practical importance simple method. (2) Linear algebra, matrix, vector, determinant and linear equations can be applied in the optimized calculation process of circuits and mechanics.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹一系列的生物大分子及構成這些生物分子的基本分子。課程從認識細菌、植物、動物細胞及各種細胞胞器開始，接著探討蛋白質、酵素、DNA、RNA、脂質、糖類結構和功能及他們在生命中的重要性。構成蛋白質的二十種氨基酸和組成DNA或RNA的四個核甘酸及構成脂質、糖類結構的生物分子將詳細被探討。
description.en: This course is to introduce a serials of biomaterials and their functions. Begins from bacterial, plant, and animal cells and the differences between these cell organs. To learn of DNA, RNA, proteins, and enzymes base on their structures and functions. The characters of 20 amino acids and 4 nucleotides will be studied in detail. Carbohydrates and lipids are learned by their specific functions.

syllabi.outline:

This course introduces animal, plant and bacterial cells and the basic structural of protein, DNA, RNA, lipid and carbohydrate.

description.zh: 無機化學係化學三大骨架之一，日常生活中之各樣物質大部分是由無機材料製成，課程係以深入淺出方式教授，授課內容涵蓋主族元素與過渡元素。課程內容包括:原理、主族元素化學、硼族、第1, 2, 15, 16, 17 族元素、過渡元素化學、過渡元素、第一過渡系列元素、鈦,鉻,鈷,鎳,銅、原子結構、鍵結理論、對稱性、振動應用和群論、分子軌域與酸鹼化學。
description.en: Inorganic chemistry is one of the three frames of chemistry. Various materials in our daily life are composed of inorganic materials. This course will be given in a manner of easy-getting-point. The contents comprise of chemistry of main group elements and transition elements. The course covers the following topics: (1) Survey of principles (2) Chemistry of main group elements (A. Boron; B. Group 1, 2, 15, 16, 17 Elements) (3) Chemistry of transition elements (A. Survey of Transition Elements; B. Elements of the first transition series; C. Titanium, Chromium, Cobalt, Nickel and Copper (4) Atomic Structure (5) Simple Bonding Theory (6) Symmetry, Vibration Application and Group Theory (7) Molecular Orbitals and (8) Acid-Base and Donor-Acceptor Chemistry.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
1. 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：
(1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件，
(2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等，
(3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應，
(4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域，
(5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。
2. 瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含：
(1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路，
(2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析，
(3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換，
(4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數，
(5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用，
(6)Laplace轉換及應用。
description.en:
The course covers the synthesis and analysis of bath linear and nonlinear circuits.Contents include:
1.Introduction to linear circuit analysis, 2. Resistive circuit, 3. Kirchhoff laws, 4. Thevenin and Norton theorem, 5. First and second order circuit, 6. Node and loop analysis, 7. Steady state response and analysis, 8. SPICE tool, 9.AC circuit :AC steady-state analysis, phasor analysis, 10. Three phase circuits, 11. Transformer circuits, 12. Frequency response, 13. Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
1. 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：
(1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件，
(2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等，
(3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應，
(4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域，
(5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。
2. 瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含：
(1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路，
(2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析，
(3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換，
(4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數，
(5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用，
(6)Laplace轉換及應用。

Steady state response and analysis, 8. SPICE tool, 9.AC circuit :AC steady-state analysis, phasor analysis, 10. Three phase circuits, 11. Transformer circuits, 12. Frequency response, 13. Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。

description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
行銷是由物品的流通及製造者對消費者或使用者所提供之服務等商業
活動所構成的。包括產品、產銷地點、通路及價格等四個主要原理。
行銷研究是幫助經營者去發展及研究市場並研擬更好之行銷計劃，包
括四種主要活動：研究計劃、收集情報、分析及發表。
description.en: This course aims to provide the student with knowledge of marketing, including product strategy, physical distribution, channel and pricing. Case study and discuss through activities (planning, investigation, analysis and presentation) that carry out strategic marketing are employed from time to time.

syllabi.outline:
本課程使同學未來在產品設計領域中，能融入所學行銷知識與技術，以填補產品設計與顧客需求之間的缺口。讓同學能一窺自己每天消費生活的各個巨微層面，期望每一同學都可經由自己消費生活的體驗而激發創意靈感，進而提升自己的設計品質，使產品設計更具「市場驅動」或「顧客導向」的意涵。
本課程以講授行銷學相關理論在產品設計上的應用為主。
1.以釋例說明來凸顯理論的實用性。
2.提供同學目前或未來在從事產品設計或行銷管理工作時，所必須具備的行銷知識和實用「工具箱」。

description.zh: 介紹傳統以及特殊加工法、製造法、金屬、非金屬材料之製造加工。
description.en: In the design and manufacturing of a product is is essential that the machine as wellas the process be understood, Manufacturing requires tools and machines that can produce products economically as well as accurately. Economy depends to a large extent on the proper selection of a machine or process that will give a satisfactory finished porduct. This course serves as an introduction to various manufacturing, foundry, special casting, and special working process.

description.zh: 本課程藉由家具相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，讓學生實際演練家具設計程序及創新方法。本課程同時配合家具材料、家具結構與實習、家具製圖、電腦輔助家具設計等課程，期能習得家具創新設計與產品工程的能力。
description.en: The course through furniture design contest or industry-academy cooperation project, let students practice the design procedure and creative methods. The course coordinate the other courses: furniture construction and practice, furniture drawing, computer aided furniture design etc, expect getting the capability of creativity design and product engineering.

syllabi.outline:
本課程藉由家具相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，讓學生實際演練家具設計程序及創新方法。本課程同時配合家具材料、家具結構與實習、家具製圖、電腦輔助家具設計等課程，期能習得家具創新設計與產品工程的能力。

此外配合USR計畫的推動，讓學生了解設計應盡的社會責任與義務，透過實務之家具設計教育示範，邀請相關專家學者至班進行互動交流與座談，達到木作高等教育向下扎根之目的，以促進未來區域的發展與在地之連結。
syllabi.schedule:
課程摘要
課程內容會透過案例分析與引導，讓學生了解設計元素的引導與文化創意的概念思維，讓學生透過真實操作去理解不同的產品設計，並導入生活化與人性化的設計概念。

教學單元
1.  文化創意思考。
2.  文化根源與元素。
3.  體驗式行銷。
4.  分組構思與合作。
5.  設計創作。
6.  設計心理與消費者
7.  市場經營與行銷。
8.  概念展現

Week 1  課程簡介
Week 2  文化創意思考導論
Week 3  傢俱設計原理與文化萃取
Week 4  分組構思與討論
Week 5  體驗式行銷與使用經驗
Week 6  傢俱設計創作與概念發想
Week 7  傢俱設計原型開發
Week 8  傢俱設計思維
Week 9  設計心理學
Week 10 人性因素觀點
Week 11 市場經營與行銷
Week 12 傢俱概念展現
Week 13 平台與商業模式
Week 14 傢俱成品展示設計
Week 15 傢俱設計展示與紀錄。
Week 16 傢俱展示設計
Week 17 期末展示設計
Week 18 期末展示
syllabi.assessment:
出席(10%)、期中發表(20%)、期末發表(30%)與創作(40%)。
各次發表以 創意度/創新性 (30%)  概念完整度(30%)  問題落實及可行性(20%) 美感 (20%) 為評分基準。

syllabi.outline:
本課程藉由家具相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，讓學生實際演練家具設計程序及創新方法。本課程同時配合家具材料、家具結構與實習、家具製圖、電腦輔助家具設計等課程，期能習得家具創新設計與產品工程的能力。
The course through furniture design contest or industry-academy cooperation project, let students practice the design procedure and creative methods. The course coordinate the other courses: furniture construction and practice, furniture drawing, computer aided furniture design etc, expect getting the capability of creativity design and product engineering.

description.zh: 課程講授家具結構之專業知識與應用技術，理論與實務並重。內容包括開發流程、產品工程、基本力學、木材特性、複合板特性、木材接合、機械扣件、框類家具結構特性、板類家具結構特性、殼類家具結構特性等。
description.en: This course is introducing the knowledge and technique of furniture construction, both theory and practicing. The contents include R&D procedure, product engineering, basic mechanics, characteristics of wood, characteristics of composite board,, wood joints, mechanical fasteners, characteristics of frame type furniture, characteristics of panel type furniture, characteristics of shell type furniture etc.

description.zh: 1.進階的設計表現技法，藉由意象表徵，仿生擬人，情境描繪等方法，探求設計表達的背後的意義。2.設計表現法主要素求是由簡易材料之運用以手繪快速描繪出蘊釀中造形，呈現將來產品形態。3.發表的概念草圖與版面設計規劃技巧，也是本課程的訓練重點。4.本課程以團對合作來執行設計表達。
description.en: 1.By mean of symbol, future scenarios to present the design means. 2.To use the simple tools, for present the concepts. 3.The presentation design is one of key subjects. 4.To use the teamwork to establish the design presentation experiences.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
本課程主要教導學生認識建築物理環境之基本理論，包含光環境、溫熱環境、空氣環境、音環境等，做為學習建築環境控制系統與建築設備之基礎。本課程內容分為七大部分，包括(一)建築氣象學概論、(二)建築微氣候環境、(三)建築採光與照明、(四)建築傳熱與隔熱、(五)室內通風換氣、(六)濕氣與結露、(七) 隔音與吸音等課題。
本學期介紹物理環境基本學理外，同時輔以相關案例補充說明，幫助學生在建築設計中能關注到使用者舒適、健康需求，並使其建築設計符合節能的永續建築要求。
description.en:
In this course, students will learn about the fundamental theories of architecture physics which include luminous environment, thermal environment, air environment, and sound environment as an introduction to understanding Systems of Environment Control and Architectural Equipment. The course is divided into 7 sections, (1) Introduction to Architecture Meteorology, (2) Architecture Microclimate, (3) Natural Lighting and Illumination of architecture, (4) Thermal Conduction and Proofing of Architecture, (5) Indoor Air Change and Ventilation, (6) Humidity and Condensation, and  (7) Sound absorption and proofing.
  In this semester, other than introducing the fundamental theories, related case studies are also incorporated as additional support to help students to be attentive toward issues such as comfort and health in their architectural design class at the same time to encourage the utilization of such knowledge to create energy saving and sustainable architectural designs.

description.zh:
現代主義運動，帶動了新建築的發展，也致使廿世紀的建築有了全新的可能。工業革命之後所帶動的，不僅僅是生產與製造的工業化，也不僅僅是資本的集中以及資本量的大幅成長。整個十九世紀的發展都是為了邁向一個全新的紀元，營建材料的開發、營建技術的發展、空間概念的突破，開創新的建築面貌以及新的建築歷史。
這個將近兩百年的建築發展，影響了廿世紀的建築教育，並且提供養分，供給新的世代的建築新發展。本課程將就十九、廿世紀的建築發展的歷史脈絡進行梳理，學生將由本課程理解今日其所進行的建築設計之來源。
description.en:
The Modern Movement of Architecture leads the development of new architecture, it thus deduce a whole new possibility of architecture. The Industrial Revolution is the motor of the whole movement. The building construction is industrialized under this overall influence to the society, not only on the concentration of capitals. The social life has been changed. Nineteenth Century is a struggling period with European tradition, moving forward to a new imagination, on the development of construction material, technics, also on the breakthrough on the spatial concept.

This evolution on architecture influences architectural education of 20th Century, and feeds the new creation of architecture. This course is to understand this historic evolution and context, to understand the source and establish knowledge in face of their future architectural activities.

description.zh: 本課程主要是在教導學生了解力學之概念與分析方法，使其具備學習結構學之基礎能力，其主要授課內容包括：1.力學之基本概念及平衡條件、2.構材之斷面性質如形心、重心、面積一次矩、慣性矩及其應用、3.結構構材承受軸向載重、扭力、彎矩之分析及設計應用、4.應力及應變之關係、5.梁之變形，柱之性質以及各種分析理論。
description.en: This course introduced the concept of mechanics and provided the principles of structural analysis, the course consists of(1)	Equations of equilibrium(2)	Frame Section Properties (3)	Shear and moment diagrams (4)	Relationships of stress and strainDeflection of beams and Column characteristics

1.General Principles 緒論 
2.Force Vectors 力向量
3.Equilibrium of a Particle 質點平衡

6.Structural Analysis 結構分析 
7.Internal Forces 內力 
8.Center of Gravity and Centroid 重心與形心
9.Moments of Inertia 慣性矩

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.en:
This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts.
Syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming languages will be introduced.
Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer
solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions
of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

This course covers advanced parts of computers and computer programming, including: operating systems, file and database, internet, C programming function and array, and C++ programming. description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.en: This course is expected to expand students' writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions.  Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.

syllabi.outline:
This course is expected to expand students' writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.

The course continues to stress accuracy in writing and emphasizes skills and strategies to improve the ability to communicate in written English. Students will also learn how to analyze and strengthen their written English and that of their classmates. The general goal of the course is to increase the academic English language proficiency of the students to a high-intermediate level in writing. 

This course focuses on the teaching of expository writing and analytical writing. Some mechanics such as correct use of English grammar, word logic, sentence structures, and punctuation marks will also be included in the instruction to help the students compose more effectively. Varied instructional activities such as peer review, classroom discussion, writing workshops, etc. are used to develop the students’ writing skills and critical thinking.

description.zh: 本課程引導學生熟悉變遷中之英美文學作品典律，並探討其形成之歷史文化背景及隨變遷所產生之時代意義。課程中將討論與作品相關之社會、政治、文化、心理、哲學、理論等議題，使學生能瞭解欣賞選讀作品，並銳化其思辯能力及分析技巧。學生須於課前詳讀作品，並於課堂上參與討論。
description.en: This course is intended not only to familiarize students with the evolving canon of British and American literatures, but also to investigate its contextual historical and cultural meanings, past as well as present. It aims to sharpen students' critical thinking ability and analytical reading skills by engaging them to discuss social, political, cultural, psychological, philosophical, and theoretical issues that are relevant to their understanding and appreciation of the selected literary works. Students are required to peruse the assigned weekly readings and participate in class discussion.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述統計學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋三個領域：敘述統計、機率理論與推論統計，其中包含概念介紹、敘述統計、機率理論、推論統計。另有統計學的應用領域於推論未知的情況以作為相關決策之依據，並包含統計軟體使用介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Statistics is to give students an introductory of statistical thinking, methods development and the assessment of credibility and value of inferences made from data.  A conceptual introduction to the field of statistics and its many applications with extensive coverage of data collection and analysis as needed to evaluate the reported results of statistical students and make a good decision will be included as well. The statistical software introduction will also be introduced in the class.

description.zh: 本課程適合一般大專行銷管理之授課。其目的在尋求優良的產品行銷管理方法，以求企業之良好利潤。本課程授課內容在使學生瞭解行銷管理之觀念，產品設計、產品運銷、促銷及訂價。相關之授課內容包括：市場區隔、市場組織、購買行為、產品開發、零售、批發、促銷、廣告及訂價程序等。
description.en: The marketing course is suitable to college student. The purpose is to find good method of product marketing, in order to pursuit good profit of enterprise. name.en: Database System and Database System and Applications

description.zh: 資料庫系統與應用課程的目的在研習資料庫設計與管理技術及其在企業的應用。本課程方向包括：資料庫管理系統架構、關聯式資料模式、關聯式資料庫設計理論、關聯查詢最佳化、關聯式資料庫管理系統：以MS SQL Server為例，以實務性方式，培養學生對資料庫系統設計開發之能力。
description.en: The objective of this course is to study the techniques of how to design and manage a database system. The topics contained in this course are: database system structure, relational database, E-R model, relational database design, query optimization, relational database management system-MS SQL Server etc. After studying this course, students should be able to design databases and manage database systems.

syllabi.outline:
資料庫系統與應用課程的目的在研習資料庫設計與管理技術及其在企業的應用。課程包括兩部分，第一部分介紹資料庫系統：包括資料庫管理系統架構、關聯式資料模式、關聯式資料庫設計理論、關聯查詢最佳化、關聯式資料庫管理系統：
第二部分介紹Power BI 資料庫數據分析以及視覺化工具的操作以及使用，以實務性方式，培養學生對資料庫系統設計及數據分析的能力。
The purpose of the database system and application courses is to study database design and management technology and its application in enterprises. The course consists of two parts. The first part introduces the database system: including the database management system architecture, relational data model, relational database design theory, relational query optimization, and relational database management system:
The second part introduces the operation and use of Power BI database data analysis and visualization tools, in a practical way, to train students to the database system design and data analysis ability.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)﹐內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力,亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This curriculum enters the step curriculum for the financial accounting. Intermediate accounting requires ever increasing knowledge and refinement of skills. Our goal is to achieve the most educational effective blend of concepts and practice relation to the current intermediate accounting body of knowledge. This course strives to provide the material needed to understand this subject area using IFRS. It may also be helpful to participate in accountant the license test and the government workers examination.

在授課過程或課堂討論充分的對話是有效學習的關鍵, 主動與建設性的互動與是學習者最基本的權與義務. 重點在於表達，並無絕對的對或錯, 而是在於希望透過學生彼此斷地提出問題與回答問題, 讓相同或相的剖析與了解相互激盪, 使得授課或討議題可以持續且深入地討, 進而釐清關鍵問題.

 以下幾點可作為衡是否有效地進主動與建設性的與: (1)積極傾聽, (2)勇於表達與議題攸關且具附加價值的意, (3)建設性地質疑, 以及(4)整合或揉合相
同或相的述; 總體表現將反映在「課程與」的成績上

考試目的在於測試學習者對個別觀與整體架構的解程, 包括課程講授, 教科書閱, 以及課堂討等內容, 以衡個別差, 並作為教學溝通效果之依據.
考試是測試學習者應該知道的課程內容, 只要有積極與課程學習者, 無須過憂慮.

syllabi.outline:
線性代數為科學與工程的基礎數學工具，本課程教授線性代數的基本概念與運算技巧。課程大綱包括：矩陣、線性聯立方程組、線性轉換、向量空間、特徵值及特徵向量、正交性與最小平方估計。
This course Linear Algebra
- is a mathematics course.
- is useful and fundamental to CSIE (and many other discipline) students.
- emphasizes both computations and concepts.
- asks you to use mathematical software packages (MATLAB, Scilab, or GNU Octave).
- guides you to read an English textbook.
- requires hard work.
本課程
- 為數學課
- 為資工領域(及許多其他專業領域)學生基礎課程
- 計算與概念並重
- 要求使用MATLAB, Scilab, 或 GNU Octave等套裝軟體
- 引導同學閱讀英文教科書
- 需要同學用功讀書
syllabi.schedule:
1. Matrix Operations (Sections 2.1 and 2.2) 矩陣運算
- To learn basic matrix arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication power, transpose, and inverse. 矩陣加、減、乘、乘方、轉置、反矩陣
2. Linear Equations (Sections 1.1 to 1.5) 線性方程式
- To understand the basic terminologies and notations of matrices and systems of linear equations, in the forms of vector equation and matrix equation. 線性聯立方程組、向量方程式、矩陣方程式
- Solving a system of linear equations by reducing a matrix to its echelon form. 解線性聯立方程組、階梯型式
Test #1
3. Introduction to Linear Independence and Linear Transformation (Sections 1.7, 1.8, and 2.3) 線性獨立與線性轉換
- First exposure to key concepts such as linear independence and linear transformation. 線性獨立與線性轉換初探
- More about the matrix inverse. 更多有關反矩陣
- To summarize the concepts for systems of n linear equations in n unknowns. 綜整n個變數n個線性方程式
Midterm Exam
3. Vector Spaces (Chapter 4) 向量空間
- Introduction to vector spaces. 向量空間簡介
- Fundamental subspaces of a matrix: column space, row space, and null space. 矩陣子空間：行空間、列空間、零空間
- Basis and dimension of a vector space. 向量空間的基底和維度
Test #2
4. Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors (Chapter 5) 特徵值與特徵向量
- To understand the meaning of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix, and the approaches to find them. 矩陣特徵值與特徵向量的意義與計算方式
- Diagonalization of a matrix (linear transformation). 矩陣的對角化
5.  Orthogonality and Least Squares (Chapter 6) 正交性與最小平方
- To introduce inner product of vectors, and thus the geometric concepts of length, distance, and angle (perpendicularity). 向量內積，長度、距離、角度(垂直)
- To be familiar with the use of orthogonal bases. 正交基底
- Least-Squares approximation. 最小平方估計
Final Exam

description.zh: 本課程介紹ARM CPU 及以ARM CPU為核心之微算機系統。內容包含：ARM CPU介紹，ARM CPU指令集，SRAM、DRAM、及Flash Memory之介紹，時序圖之閱讀，記憶體及I/O解碼，串列I/O及並列I/O之介紹，計時及計數器之使用，震盪器介紹，A/D及D/A轉換，中斷之使用，及應用實例之介紹。
description.en: This course covers the following topics: introduction to ARM CPU, instruction set of ARM CPU, introduction to DRAM, SRAM and Flash memory, reading of timing diagrams, decoding of memory and I/O, parallel and serial ports, using timers and counters, oscillators, A/D and D/A converters, interrupts, and case study.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電路基本元件與電路之分析方法，內容包含： 1.基本電路元件：電壓源、電流源、電阻器、電容器、電感器 2.柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律，簡單電阻電路，節點分析與網目分析 3.電路學定理：重疊定理、戴維寧與諾頓定理 4.一階電路 5.二階電路 6.弦波穩態分析 7.頻率響應 8.雙埠電路
description.en: The course introduces the basic circuit elements and the methods for analyzing circuits. The topics include: 1.Basic circuit elements: voltage sources, current sources, resistors, capacitors, inductors 2.Kirchhoff voltage and current laws, simple resistive circuits, node analysis and mesh analysis 3.Circuits theorems: superposition principle, Thevenin and Norton theorems 4.First-order circuits 5.Second-order circuits 6.Sinusoidal steady-state analysis 7.Frequency responses 8.Two-port networks

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 即使科學昌明如此，但我們日常生活中使用的、不斷推陳出新的照相機、攝錄影機、影印機等，在在都說明幾何光學現在仍然是主宰設計的工具。光學主要是藉著對光本質方面的瞭解，發展有關的理論基礎與計算法則，並進而用在日常生活且增益人類福祉的一門科學。幾何光學則是光學理論中，一連串近似運算的結果，著重在成像的效果和應用的一門工具性知識。本系之幾何光學是一學期、三學分、每週三小時的課程，教學內容大致包含以下三部份：一、介紹光的性質、在介面上反射、折射之有關定理、成像的原因及應用。二、分析像差現象及其成因與評估。三、淺介透鏡之設計。
description.en: Light is the principal means by which we gain knowledge of the world. From putting continually the improved camera, video cassette recorder, copying machine, etc., to market can just account for how important a designing tool the Geometric-Optics is.To build a solid basic theory and a rule for calculating through understanding thoroughly the nature of light is the central goal of Optics. Using the basic theory of optics and processes of approximate estimate, the Geometric-Optics put its point on image formation and its applications.Here in our department, the Geometric-Optics is a 3-credit, 3-hour per week, one-semester course. There are three consecutives parts in the one-semester lecture:The 1st part : (a)the nature of light, (b)the related theorems about reflection and refraction, (c) image formation.The 2nd part : the formation and correctness of aberrations.The 3rd part : the designing of lenses.

syllabi.outline:
光學可分為幾何光學與波動光學。幾何光學偏重於巨觀的光線特性探討，包含光的傳導、散射、反射、折射、成像等，是一門工具性知識。
        本系之幾何光學是一學期、三學分、每週三小時的課程。教學內容大致包含以下三部份：
一、介紹光的性質、在介面上反射、折射之有關定理、成像的原因及應用。
二、分析像差現象及其成因與評估。
三、淺介透鏡之設計。

syllabi.outline:
電路學主要是介紹「電源」、「電阻」、「電晶體」、「電容」、「電感」等基本電子元件的組合應用， 分成提供電力的主動式元件「電壓源」與「電流源」，還有消耗電力的被動式元件「電阻」，所組成的電路可簡單分成 由「電源」、「電阻」、「電晶體」所組成的「靜態電路」與 由「電源」、「電容」、「電感」所組成的「動態電路」。 電子在電路中的流動行為與物體質量的流動行為相似，電路中的克希霍夫電流定律(KCL)等同於物體質量流動的連續方程， 也就是「電荷守恆定律」及「質量守恆定律」；電路中的克希霍夫電壓定律(KVL)等同於物體質量受重力或守恆力(Conservative Forces) 作用下的位能變化。
Circuits mainly introduces the combined application of basic electronic components such as "power", "resistance", "transistor", "capacitor", "inductance" and so on. It is divided into the active components "voltage source" and "current source" that provide power. There is also a passive component "resistor" that consumes power. The circuit formed can be simply divided into a "static circuit" consisting of "power", "resistance", and "transistor" and a "power", "capacitor", and "inductance". "Dynamic circuit" composed of. The flow behavior of electrons in the circuit is similar to the flow behavior of the mass of an object. The Kirchhoff current law (KCL) in the circuit is equivalent to the continuous equation of the mass flow of an object, that is, the "law of conservation of charge" and "the law of conservation of mass"; The Kirchhoff voltage law (KVL) in the circuit is equivalent to the potential energy change of the mass of an object under the action of gravity or conservation forces (Conservative Forces).

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.zh: 即使科學昌明如此，但我們日常生活中使用的、不斷推陳出新的照相機、攝錄影機、影印機等，在在都說明幾何光學現在仍然是主宰設計的工具。光學主要是藉著對光本質方面的瞭解，發展有關的理論基礎與計算法則，並進而用在日常生活且增益人類福祉的一門科學。幾何光學則是光學理論中，一連串近似運算的結果，著重在成像的效果和應用的一門工具性知識。本系之幾何光學是一學期、三學分、每週三小時的課程，教學內容大致包含以下三部份：一、介紹光的性質、在介面上反射、折射之有關定理、成像的原因及應用。二、分析像差現象及其成因與評估。三、淺介透鏡之設計。
description.en: Light is the principal means by which we gain knowledge of the world. From putting continually the improved camera, video cassette recorder, copying machine, etc., to market can just account for how important a designing tool the Geometric-Optics is.To build a solid basic theory and a rule for calculating through understanding thoroughly the nature of light is the central goal of Optics. Using the basic theory of optics and processes of approximate estimate, the Geometric-Optics put its point on image formation and its applications.Here in our department, the Geometric-Optics is a 3-credit, 3-hour per week, one-semester course. There are three consecutives parts in the one-semester lecture:The 1st part : (a)the nature of light, (b)the related theorems about reflection and refraction, (c) image formation.The 2nd part : the formation and correctness of aberrations.The 3rd part : the designing of lenses.

description.en:
The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. 
In the first year, the course focuses on : (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language.
In the second and the third year, the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. 
In the fourth year, we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 文化專題（一）課程培養同學認識臺灣不同族群的生活文化，介紹各領域與各時期的文化特色，包括：原住民各族文化、荷西鄭氏時期的多元文化、農業移墾文化、日治臺灣的近代文化、臺灣近代社會變遷、當代文藝發展與變遷、大眾文化與全球化。
description.en: This course is designed to cultivate the students' understanding of life culture from different groups in Taiwan. Students will learn the introduction of cultural feature from each areas and periods. These cultural features include the aboriginal culture, the multicultural when Taiwan is under Dutch and Spanish rule and in the Zheng period, the culture of reclaiming agriculture, the modern culture when Taiwan is under Japanese rule, the society transition of modern Taiwan, the development and transition of the modern literature and art, popular culture and globalization.

description.zh: 中國文化淵遠流長，歷數千年而不衰，涵蓋範園既廣且深。本課程授課內容，是透過物質生活(衣、食、住、行)，集體生活(社會、政治組織)，精神生活(文學、藝術、哲學、宗教信仰)等之介紹，讓學生對中國文化有更進一步的認識與了解。授課方式以口頭講授為主，討論及書面報告為輔，使得上課方式更為生動與活潑。
description.en: Chinese culture is a time-honored history, and never fades after undergoing several thousand years. The scope of Chines culture is immeasurable and deep. The contents of this course including the introduction of material life (clothing, food, housing and transportation), collective life (society, politics, and organization), and spiritual life (literature, art, philosophy and religious belief). Students will obtain further cognition and acquaintance about Chinese culture. The teaching mode is by giving students a lecture orally, and students have to discuss and hand in written reports. The teaching style is more vivacious.

description.zh: 文字是高度文明社會的產物，在社群中，繼語言的溝通目的，進而成為記載與保存的重要媒介。中國幅員廣大地域又常隔絕，書寫和通讀一種共通的文字對於多民族的融合與歷史文化的傳承深具關鍵作用。中國的文字相對於西洋拼音文字又稱為漢字，由於書寫工具及負載材料的變易，文字書寫發展出歷代遞嬗各風貌，尤其毛筆的運用展現各階段多樣的線條藝術。隨著傳統士人身份發生變化，依附於傳統文化並作為傳統政教倫理工具和文人清譽標誌的書法，也產生價值跌宕。書法在歷史流變中逐漸成為獨立藝術，民國以來以現代型態的美學觀念闡釋書法這一古典傳統藝術，從而確立書法的現代美學性質。
description.en: Compared to Western phonetic writing, Chinese writing is also known as Han characters. Due to changes in writing tools and materials, the development of Chinese writing has undergone various transformations throughout the ages, with the use of brushes showcasing various styles of line art at different stages. As the traditional scholar identity evolved, calligraphy, which relied on traditional culture and served as a tool for political education and a badge of honor for literati, also experienced fluctuations in value. Calligraphy gradually became an independent art form over time and has been interpreted with modern aesthetic concepts since the establishment of the Republic of China, thus establishing the modern aesthetic nature of calligraphy.

description.zh: 本課程是針對有志從事文化創意產業的學生而設計的創意策略與企劃課程。課程從廣告的基本概念開始說明，如產品的開發策略、市場規模估計、競爭產品的研究和分析、消費者行為研究、SWOT、3C等。本課程的目的是以創新思考和市場行銷概念引導學生，並鼓勵學生從當前的創意產業中，發掘潛在機會，以創造新鮮且有趣的想法。
description.en: This course is a strategy and general project management for students interested in pursuing careers in the cultural and creative industry. The course starts from the basic concepts and functions in the advertising, such as the development of product strategy, market size estimation, competitor identification and analysis, consumer behavior research, SWOT, 3Cs, and so on. This course aims to guide students equipped with innovation thinking and marketing sense. Additionally, the course drives students to look through potential opportunities in the creative industry and to implement new and interesting ideas.

syllabi.outline:
企劃，雖是紙上談兵，但有意思的提案確實可幫助與這計畫相關的人，不只是客戶，另外如同事、支援團隊等，都可一同進入情境，進而讓紙上提案成為實際發生的專案。

課程目標：1. 同學將理解「每個專題以概念清楚為首要，後續才有文案與視覺設計」的次序性；2. 競品分析。

本課程以創意、設計等領域為說明案例，近期因科技發展與疫情現況，創意產業重視的體驗式經驗，開始有了新面貌，逐漸朝向「實體與虛擬混合」的體驗式經驗。課程預計分成兩個階段：第一階段先給同學理解企劃提案簡報的基本原則。第二階段，則是請同學以原則為基礎，開始變形。課堂會提供與我們生活環境相關的題目，預期開展同學「前期研究」、「提出主張」、「口語簡報／文字簡報」、「製作圖表」、「專案視覺方向」等能力。因此，這不在於題目是否具備商業價值，而是鼓勵同學能提出完整且具深刻性的企劃提案。

*鼓勵同學於課餘時間，盡可能從「觀察、紀錄」中，探索你的生活環境。

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋文化典藏的徵集、維護與管理過程，並著重各項資料的編排、描述與加值應用。課程目標在培養學生具備文化典藏智能，包括：1. 認識文化典藏機構、典藏物件的類型與特性，以及永久保存的相關概念；2. 理解文化典藏著錄的方式與基本原則；3. 具備文化典藏資料查找、評估與運用之素養。
description.en: This course covers the process of acquiring, maintaining and managing cultural collections, and focuses on the organization, description and value-added application of various collection. The goal of the course is to provide students with knowledge of cultural collections, including: 1. an understanding of the types and characteristics of institutions and objects in cultural collections, as well as the concept of permanent preservation; 2. an understanding of the methods and basic principles of description in cultural collections; 3. the ability to locate, evaluate, and apply information in cultural collections.

syllabi.outline: 本課程涵蓋數位時代中一手檔案史料的整理與數位化過程，著重檔案資料的典藏管理與加值應用。課程目標在於培養學生的檔案智能，包括：1. 認識檔案資料類型與特性，以及數位保存的相關概念；2. 理解檔案編排分類與描述著錄等資訊組織的基本原則3. 具備檔案資料查找、評估與運用數位典藏等檔案專業素養。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include: probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

syllabi.outline:
為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與投資決策支援系統運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫以及財金資訊網站的應用。藉由上述資訊工具與技術，將金融投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1)證券投資導論；(2)金融市場與投資商品；(3)投資理論中的內容與實務，包括投資基礎、證券市場、報酬率模式與投資組合、股價分析與衍生性商品等。課程分別就理論與實務案例說明。
透過由投資理論與實務教學中，清楚瞭解其投資概念，以制訂出理性的長短期投資決策。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程在使學生瞭解數位音樂的製作流程、MIDI的基本概念、混音器基本架構、基本錄音技術、音樂軟體工具之分類與簡介等，並透過實務練習，學習音效、音樂剪輯的基本技術。
description.en: The topics of this course covers the introduction of the workflow in digital music production, the basics of MIDI, the elements of mixing consoles, the basics of recording techniques, the introduction of digital music software, etc. In addition, the students will also learn the techniques of sound effect production and the basic sound editing through practical exercises.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，配合設計實務的操作，使學生能充分了解使用者介面設計的流程以及相關的應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作的能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related application, so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and design work.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。 課程規劃主要著重在"設計方法"以及"設計思維(Design Thinking)的實際操作演練;希望透過本課程讓同學們以互動體驗實作的方式來建構設計概念發展的模式。 課程內容包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫及實作等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。
description.en: This course is focused on the introduction of animation planning and design, as well as its principle and application. Through the study on the internet, animation, game and other digital media, students can understand the design process of animation, story drafting and software application.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。

透過理論講解和操作示範介紹電腦動畫的原理和方法。除了功能的訓練之外同時也著重動畫的美感、創造性、表演性等等運用面的需求。
使用軟體是以3Ds Max為主，在熟悉3d max工具的同時，更明確的認清原創為藝術創作的首要目標，以利用此軟體多元並高度的掌控性，重組現實世界的運行法則，像是重力、光影、質感等，並企圖創造出各種感知進化的契機。此動畫課程除了包含進階的建模、材質與運算，將加入角色製作與攝影機語言的敘述搭配空間與物件造形所傳達之視覺感知，將時間性的美感與張力融入創作。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

syllabi.schedule:
Week:1
Topic: Introduction to modern programming languages 介紹近代程式設計語言與差異(機械語言、組合語言、CC++/C#語言、Java/Python語言、程式設計的重點與目標)

Week: 2
Topic: Program Variables and Operators 基本程式設計之變數、常數與資料運算元

Week: 3
Topic: Program Output 基本程式設計之螢幕輸出 Print

Week: 4
Topic: Program Loop 程式迴圈 (說明 for, while 迴圈的基礎認識，與迴圈終止方式)

Week: 5
Topic: Program Jump and Flow Control 邏輯判斷 (說明 if, else 邏輯判緞的基礎認識)

Week: 6
Topic: Array, List and Dictionary 陣列、串列與字典(說明各種進階資料結構的基本運算方式)

Week: 7
Topic: Windows Controls Processing 程式視窗輸出 (說明視窗元件的基本控制方式)

Week: 8
Topic: Windows Program 視窗程式設計 (前述技巧與綜合應用)

Week: 9
Topic: 期中考試

Week: 10
Topic: User Defined Function 自訂副程式 (說明 自訂函式，與呼叫方式)

Week: 11
Topic: String Processing One 字串處理-1 (說明字串變數與字串常數的差異，交互套用字串變數與字串常數的方式)

Week: 12
Topic: File Processing One 檔案處理-1 (說明磁碟檔案的基本認識與操作方式)

Week: 13
Topic: String Processing Two 字串處理-2 (說明字串變數操作與部分資料擷取)

Week: 14
Topic: Simple Constructive Program 簡易結構化程式設計 (前述技巧與綜合應用)

Week: 15
Topic: File Processing Two 檔案處理 (說明檔案操作與字串變數的進階操作方式)

Week: 16
Topic: Exception Handle 例外處理 (說明 try-except 基礎認識，與錯誤處理方式)

Week: 17
Topic: Debug Skills 除錯技巧 (說明 程式錯誤的偵測方式)

Week: 18
Topic: 期末考試

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

syllabi.outline:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞、思考、創作與文字及口語之表達能力，並特重文化教材之選讀，使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化能有深入認識，從而培植其人文素養，啟發其尊重自我、關懷他者乃至環境之情操。
三、本課程另計畫教授「新六藝」——書藝、棋藝、武藝、園藝、茶藝、樂藝，為時計三年，分布於前六學期，以期使學生除於重視學習生存能力（專業）外，能進而體會「學生」之深意，更在學習生活品味，乃至學習生命意義，以此陶冶情性，成就全人格之教育。
四、本課程亦教授應用文，如履歷、自傳與名片等之撰寫 (四年級），並安排模擬面試活動，俾使學生能與畢業後之謀職一事提早接軌。

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，培養學生邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.多項式，2.不等式及其應用，3.直角坐標及函數，4.三角函數及其應用，5.複數，6.平面之圓錐曲線，7.指數及對數函數，8.向量，9.矩陣，10.三度空間的基本觀念，11.數列與級數，12.排列組合與機率。
description.en: The course aims at: developing comprehension of algebra, trigonometry, analytical geometry, activating capabilities of logic inference and induction, enlightening confidence and independence, strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and graph, furnishing a sound basis for future specialty including Calculus. The content includes: 1.Polynomial, 2.Inequalities and its Application, 3.Rectangular Coordinate System and Functions, 4.Trigonometric Functions and its Application , 5.Complex Numbers, 6.Conic Section, 7. Exponential and Logarithmic Functions, 8.Vectors, 9.Matrix, 10.Elementary Concept of Three Dimensional Space, 11.Sequences and Series, 12.Permutation, Combination and Probability.
