description.zh: 大稻埕文創社區經營結合歷史、建築、文化、音樂、茶道、祭典與近代社會運動、歷史遺跡，組合成豐富的大稻埕文化，藉由對此社區活動的認識，結合現代文創元素，讓學子對台北的古遺跡有更深刻的認識，並打造「大稻埕」成為歷史街區活化的國際品牌，期盼在提升台灣學子的「就業即戰力」與「國際移動力」的同時，也成為當今我國文化外交戰略的重要環節。
description.en: The community management of Dadaocheng creative zone combines her own history, architecture, culture, music, tea ceremony, ceremonies and modern social movements, historical relics into a rich specific Dadaocheng culture, through propagating her community activities combined with modern creative elements.  We expect our students to improve their " employment agility" and "international mobility", by enabling them to have a deeper understanding of specific Dadaocheng culture. And then, Dadaocheng being an international brand is an important part of Taiwanese cultural diplomacy strategy.

syllabi.outline:
課程大綱
本課程在使學生了解各種資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，包含目前熱門資訊科技議題以及發展趨勢，並以實際個案進行學術研究。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。上課方式為教師資訊系統議題分享、論文探討、個案分系討論以及分組課堂報告討論為主，訓練學生提出具有研究價值之論文研究計畫為目標，本課程目的有三：
(一)	建立學生對總體數位科技環境的認知，提升未來職場資訊技術以及學術研究之觀念性技能開發。
(二)	訓練研究生學術期刊論文研讀及講評能力。
(三)	透過分組進行研究探討及口頭練習論文發表及論文研究計畫大綱撰寫。

description.zh: 本課程主要闡述財務管理中最重要的投資決策、融資決策與短期資金管理決策之基本架構及企業經理人之財務決策，配合各項相關議題進行個案研討，結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹財務管理之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務管理的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的融資與投資決策制定。課程內容涵蓋：金融市場與金融機構、財務報表與現金流量分析、財務規劃與預測、風險與報酬、債券與股票之評價、資金成本、資本預算決策、資本結構與財務槓桿、營運資金管理、股利政策…等。本課程結合財務管理實務並融入財務決策研討，以培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才。透過本課程之修習，期許學生能具備財務管理領域之學科知識與專業技術整合能力、獨立研究之能力、判斷性思考與決策能力，以及制訂並解決財務管理問題之能力。

description.zh: 本課程能夠讓修課學生靈活的運用各種大數據探勘與分析演算法、社群文字探勘及機器學習演算法等技術，分析各項金融資料。透過實際金融數據分析案例及實務資料操做，補強資訊背景學生之金融產業知識，並讓修課同學了解資訊科技於金融資料分析之實務應用，以培育業界金融科技人才。課程內容以模組的方式進行，包括：「數據分析」、「機器學習」以及「金融大數據實務」。課程也將擷取網路中的開放財經數據，進行金融資料之預處理、分析及預測結果之驗證，協助修課學生建構高預測能力及穩定性之數據探勘模型。
description.en: This course teaches students to use various techniques of big data mining and analysis algorithms, text mining of social media, and machine learning algorithms to analyze financial data. In this course, by case study and open software operation (such as R ), we will strengthen the financial knowledge of information background students. Also, the students can understand how to select and well organize various information technologies (particular the data analysis technique) to analyze financial data. The course is organized in modules, including "Data Analysis", "Machine Learning" and "Big Data Practice for Financial Data analysis." The course will also teach students to collect open financial data from the Internet, and experience the KDD process, including: data pre-processing and data analysis, to establish a prediction model with high forecasting ability and stability.

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

description.zh: 來自於內部與外部的攻擊使企業在系統及網路保護遭遇許多挑戰，為了有效控制企業風險，政府在內部控制相關法規明確要求資訊系統相關的內部控制，而電腦稽核為確保內部控制的關鍵角色。本課程內容以國際電腦稽核師(CISA)認證的各項領域內容為主。期望學生能夠對於瞭解資訊系統稽核及其風險管理相關概念有初步的瞭解，進而瞭解資訊安全及資訊系統稽核的機制與手法，作為協助學生順利考取國際電腦稽核師(CISA)認證碁石。
description.en: Internal and external attacks have caused enterprises to encounter many challenges in system and network protection. In order to effectively control enterprise risks, the government's accounting regulations explicitly require information system-related internal controls, and computer audit is a key role for ensuring internal control. The content of this course is based on the content of various fields of the International Computer Auditor (CISA) certification. Students are expected to have a preliminary understanding of the information system audit and its risk management related concepts, and then understand the mechanisms and techniques of information security and information system auditing. Finally, it is expected as a way to help students successfully obtain the CISA certification.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或理論論文寫作之能力。研究方法一強調量化研究，課程內容包含研究的基本概念、文獻探討、研究問題、研究變項、研究假設、研究設計、資料蒐集與分析、研究工具、研究樣本、研究倫理與研究論文撰寫等。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en:
The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis.
This research methods one focus on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis, research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

description.zh: 本課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有全面性的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、理論與實務基礎、互動設計方法與技術、科技支援與應用、認知心理、情境設計以及電腦支援協同合作等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。
description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, interaction design methods and techniques, technical support and application, cognitive psychology, scenario design and CSCW. Course also incorporates case studies and company visits to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

Principle of Interaction Design: Autumn 2020 - Syllabus
Meeting Times and Location: Tuesday, periods: 5-6,

Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang
Instructor Office Location and Hours: Room705-2, Design College bldg., Tuesday, periods: 7-9 and Monday 3-4.
Instructor Contact Information: E-mail: ryan5885@mail.ntut.edu.tw

Course Description: 
"Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in the areas of visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is the link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” to take place between users and design.
 In this course, we will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and have opportunity to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and practices of interaction design. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function" and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences, and understand the role that interaction with contents and installment fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This is a class with time devoted to lecture, discussion, practice activities, design work sessions, and critique of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design.

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於培養學生具備以下的能力：1. 使學生具備能夠把「抽象概念」轉換成實務設計的基本能力。2. 培養學生有美感欣賞與基本應用技巧的能力。3. 訓練學生具有獨立思考與解決問題的視覺構成能力。4. 具備認識感官資訊處理過程以及傳遞原理的基本能力。5. 能了解視覺、聽覺以及空間互動資訊如何運作以及應用的能力。6. 學習如何運用相關的方法、整合相關專業知識與技能於資訊設計上。
description.en: This course is expected to train students to be equipped with the following abilities: 1. Ability to transforming the abstract ideas into practical design. 2. Ability of aesthetic appreciation and basic application skills. 3. Visual construction ability of independent thinking and problem-solving. 4. Understanding of perceived information processing and communication principle. 5 Understanding of knowledge and application of visual, acoustic and spacial interaction information. 6. Learning how to apply relevant methods and integrate knowledge and techniques to practical information design.

syllabi.outline: 互動設計可視為三大傳統設計領域：平面設計、工業設計，與建築設計的延伸。在許許多多延伸出來的新設計領域如 UI、UX、響應式網頁、互動產品、智慧空間等等，圖像依舊是所有設計在發想、討論，與實現設計上所仰賴的根本工具。本課程以圖像為設計語言的架構下，介紹由圖像所發展出來的數位生產線，以模組技術介紹互動設計在設計發想、原型製作，以至到設計討論與提案所需要之圖像技術，並鼓勵學生以一設計提案來總結課堂之所學。

description.zh: 本課程介紹整合即時影像、即時音訊、實體裝置、及相關表演科技（如燈光控制、各類感應器應用等）之技術與應用實務，並藉由圖形化、物件導向程式設計系統，引導未有程式設計經驗的視覺設計者或輔助已有程式設計能力者，以更有效率的方式進行相關互動系統設計，藉以達成互動裝置、表演科技、與表演藝術之整合。
description.en: This course introduces the technology that help integrates real-time video, audio, installations, and associated performance arts technology (such as lighting control, the application of various types of sensors, etc.) into performing arts. Through a graphical, object-oriented programming system, the course is intended to help visual designers with no programming experiences or to assist experienced programmers to efficiently design the interactive systems that combine interactive installations, performance arts technology, and performing arts itself as a whole.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將探討互動科技運用於當代表演藝術、裝置設計之可能性與相關發展，並介紹互動表演形式與美學、電腦視覺與電腦聆聽、即時影像處理、即時音訊合成等，藉由實際展演計畫之提案與執行，透過跨領域合作，讓學生有機會將互動科技、互動裝置、表演藝術三者結合。本課程將注重展演計畫之提案與發想、表演之腳本安排、舞台與互動裝置設計、互動影音應用設計等。

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹使用者經驗設計之理論與研究方法。藉由本課程的學習，學生能習得互動設計過程中所需要之關鍵概念 - 以使用者經驗為中心之設計。課程以人-機-境之架構為基礎進行相關知識之講授，並透過相關研究案例之研討、方法之操作以及設計研究之進行了解其原理。課程內容包含人物誌、使用者經驗與需求、互動環境、使用者研究以及認知心理基礎等。教學將以課堂講授、文獻閱讀以及研究方法操作等方式進行，並以報告繳交、分組討論與發表為評量方式。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theories, application and research of User-Centered Design (UCD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UCD, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory and case study. The contents include user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, usability design and evaluation, user-centered product design and development, design psychology and universal design. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, professional seminar and case study, and evaluated by students' reports, group discussion and presentation.

This course is focused on introducing the theories and research methods of User Experience Design (UXD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UX, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory, and executed through research case studies, method simulation and design research. The contents include personas, user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, user research and cognitive psychology. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, literature review and research conducting. Students are evaluated by reports, group discussion and presentation.

description.en: The purpose of this course is try to help students prepare to operate in and contribute to the 21st century. Regardless of whether a person intends to work in a business, for the government, or in a nonprofit organization, the concepts, strategies, and techniques of effective marketing are relevant. This course is: Providing from fundamental concepts through the major tasks associated with marketing to the strategic role of marketing in an organization. Bringing early attention to the global nature of marketing. Emphasizing the similarities as well as the differences between consumer and business marketing. Combining demand forecasting with its logical antecedents-segmentation, targeting, and position. Covering marketing research, after students have been exposed to consumer and business markets and segmentation. Integrating planning, implementation, and evaluation to provide a broad strategic context after students have a grasp of what marketing entails.

syllabi.outline:
The objectives of this course are as follws:
1.	To learn key content/context /concept about Marketing in theory and in real-world, the importance of Marketing, its Scope/definition, and review the core concepts of new Marketing.
2.	This course will also entail the 10 main types of marketers marketed, and how do they prospect into the marketplace, and who and what are the basic markets. While in the marketplace, how the sellers and buyers are connected and extended by key customers groups and target markets.
3.	With corporate core value proposition, students will alliance key elements with the course process to design a suggested proper Semester-Long marketing plan project. By using Kotler, it will enable students to extend their vision while using the Examples and case studies in the textbook. And students also need to learn the Core Marketing Concepts： Marketing Environment , both inside and outside the organization, TPS, Brands and offers, Value and Satisfaction, Societal forces, Marketing Channel, Supply Chain, and another competition watch, which may affect the marketing result. 
4.	To understand the Marketing subject, an art and science combination in a holistic approach.

Learning Methods:
1. Reading classical text and modern related articles, where the group will share their insight by the presentation.
2. Study journal paper: encourage students to learn to publish short articles or apply the mini-project.
3. Site visiting: Creative clusters and museums, learning how creative industry working employees are different from other areas, and what learners will view the world after studying these subjects.

description.en: This course deals with management accounting and control both within a micro-behavioural and within an organisational theory perspective. The aim is to provide an understanding of the developments in management accounting and control theory and practice and the implications of critical variables that affect the design, development and operation of management accounting and control systems. Practical aspects of management accounting are mainly examined through computer assisted learning (CAL). Students are expected to cover the prescribed reading on their own, and to perceive the taught seminars as the opportunity to ask questions and to offer their views at any time.

syllabi.outline: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This research method course focuses on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis (i.e. SPSS), research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生們一個可以改善他們的科技英文寫作技巧的環境，內容將包括：1. 扼要複習英文句型與文法，2. 撰寫論文常發生的錯誤，3. 分享論文審稿的經驗，4. 提供淺顯實用的寫作原則，5. 同儕分享讀論文與寫作的錯誤心得。
description.en: This course provides an environment to help students improving their English skill in writing technical paper or thesis. What will be included in the class are: 1. concise review of sentence structure and grammar, 2. frequent writing mistakes of paper or report, 3. share of the experience in paper review, 4. offering simple and practical writing principles, 5. share the experience in reading and writing papers.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to improve reading and writing skills. We will review the grammar, the articles, and the tense. After that, we will also discuss the common mistakes during writing. Then you will learn how to improve sentence fluency and how to structure an illustration paragraph. Gradually, you will learn how to write an essay. During the course, you will also read some articles from other journals to improve your reading skills.

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

In the end, all students taking this course have been requested to write a manuscript and submit it to a refereed journal with a rigorous review mechanism.

description.zh: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。
description.en: The main goal of this class is to pursue sustainable development and human health. In order to enhance the quality of residential and living environment in both existing and new-build dwellings, the course will cover important principles and topics in sick building environment, including medical, regulation, and architecture, chemical and biological. Specific contents include: (1)Conception of healthy environment: To explain the "sick building" and explore the association between indoor air and health.(2)Pollution source from buildings: To investigate the chemicals emission from building materials and their effect on human health, and get the countermeasures on reduce the indoor pollutants.(3)Pollution source from Biological: To investigate the indoor air pollution that cause by the mold, mites, termites, and pets.(4)Diagnostic techniques: To improved indoor air quality and sick building by diagnostic methods, with the case studies to prevent indoor environmental quality on new and old

syllabi.outline:
Healthy Building Environment（1）

The main goal of this course is to built environment that encourages positive well-being of human beings. This course will introduce the healthy building and environment that between human health and the built environment and to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Different factors in a building affect its safety and hygiene. The factors such as lighting, quality of air, thermal comfort, aural comfort, colors, mind, movement, water , Nourishment ,materials ,and community are known to have a positive relationship with a healthy built environment.
The course will be conducted in the following main topics.

A. Air Quality：To achieve high levels of air quality across a building’s lifetime through diverse strategies that include source elimination or reduction, active and passive building design and operation strategies and human behavior interventions.

B. Materials: to reduce human exposure, whether direct or through environmental contamination, to chemicals that may impact health during the construction, remodeling, furnishing and operation of buildings.

C. Thermal Comfort：To promote human productivity and provide a maximum level of thermal comfort among all building users through improved HVAC system design and control and by meeting individual thermal preferences.

D. Light : create lighting environments that promote visual, mental and biological health.

E. Sound : the identification and mitigation of acoustical comfort parameters that shape occupant experiences in the built environment.

F. Movement and Fitness: promotes physical activity in everyday life through environmental design, policies and programs to ensure that movement opportunities are integrated into the fabric of our culture, buildings and communities.

G.mind: promotes mental health through policy, program and design strategies that seek to address the diverse factors that influence cognitive and emotional well-being.

H.Water : All aspects of the quality, distribution and control of liquid water in buildings.

description.zh: 本課程將包含使用者經驗設計的基礎，以及使用者研究量測的內涵及方法。本課程中，將透過課堂上課、討論、以及實習的方式，介紹使用者研究的實際案例、評估模式、團隊合作方法、設計與評估工具、實踐思維、挑戰、以及實際執行的程序。預期學生將於本課程中，透過分組獲得使用者經驗在互動設計、空間設計以及產品設計上，有關使用者研究的設計、評估、施行、以及質化與量化分析量測評估的知識與方法。
description.en: This course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design and product design individually.

syllabi.outline:
As the internet has grown and become pervasive in our lives, the world has gotten smaller. More and more, as consumers, we can share our experiences. For a company, great experiences can be a competitive advantage. They can keep your customers loyal and turn them into your biggest cheerleaders. On the flip side, terrible experiences can stop you in your tracks very quickly. No one wants to be that company being talked about for all the wrong reasons. Building great user experiences requires listening and empathy. In this course, you’ll learn the tools and techniques to make your design/products delightful for users.
This course is an introduction to User Experience with a focus on Space, Product, and Interaction Design. Students create a complete UX brief, from ideation to annotated wireframes that could be handed off to a developer to be built. They will also learn to conduct the research necessary and create all the supporting documentation required to defend their design decisions. There is a large focus on how to dissect and analyze common design patterns.
This class is an interdisciplinary integration course. The majority of students are design college students looking to transition their skills into digital, or product managers looking to improve their design skills. Other students often include engineers who want to learn how to make their design/products more usable and entrepreneurs looking to build out the user experience for their idea.
Overall, this course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models, and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing, and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing, and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design, and product design individually

description.zh: 本課程介紹如何將電化學技術應用於生物燃料電池上。生物燃料電池的觸媒主要是由酵素或是微生物甚至是生物細胞所組成，反應過程區分為電子直接轉移(mediatorless)與間接轉移(mediator)，並介紹此各種生物燃料電池的原理及應用，個別討論電池之反應過程、電池電極材料、電化學修飾電極及各種不同電池電解質溶液等個別元件。
description.en: The aim and purpose of this course is to introduce and expand the electrochemistry to develop the biofuel cells. Generally the catalysts of biofuel cell are composed by enzymes, microbial, creature cells and the bio-reduction process. In the biofuel cells the reaction process can be distinguished into mediator less and mediator transfer process. In this course, we will introduce the principle, reaction process and the application of biofuel cells. Especially, a detailed study about the utilization of film modified electrodes and different electrolyte solutions for the development of biofuel cells.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。

name.en: The History and Culture of Taiwan

description.zh: 台灣位處東南亞與東北亞島弧的中介點，是亞洲大陸與太平洋的接點，因此，歷來有許多不同族群移居，因而形成多彩多樣的多元價值觀並容兼蓄的文化觀。本課程將論述介紹台灣南島文化、荷西殖民時期的基督教、漢人文化、日本文化和近代文明等在台灣社會產生的影響。
description.en: The island of Taiwan is located in the middle of the island arc of Southeastern and Northeastern Asia. Further, it is the intersection of the Asian continent and the Pacific Ocean. Since many different ethnic groups have migrated in together, a multi-dimensional view of value-colorful in itself has thus been formed. This course will make a first-step introduction and discussion on the impact over the Taiwan society processed by the cultural mix of the Austronesians, the Christianity under the occupation of the Netherlands and Spain, the Hans, the Japanese and the modern civilization.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims at developing comprehension of derivation and integral、activating capabilities of logic inference and induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content of Calculus(I)
includes: 1.Functions and Limits, 2.Derivatives, 3.Inverse Functions (includes 
Transcendental Functions), 4.Applications of Differentiation, 5.Integrals,
6.Techniques of Integration.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 ---Functions, The limit of a function, Calculating limits
Week 2 ---Continuity, Limits involving infinity
Week 3 ---Derivatives and rates of change, The derivative as a function,
         Basic differentiation formulas, The product and quotient rules
Week 4 ---The chain rule, Implicit differentiation, Related rates,
         Linear approximations and differentials
Week 5 ---Exponential functions, Inverse functions and Logarithms,
        Derivatives of Logarithmic and Exponential functions
Week 6 ---Test1
Week 7 ---Exponential Growth and Decay, Hyperbolic functions, Indeterminate forms and L’Hospital’s rule
Week 8 ---Maximum and minimum values, The mean value theorem
Week 9 ---Derivatives and the shapes of graphs
Week 10 –Curve sketching
Week 11 –Optimization problems, Newton’s method, Antiderivatives
Week 12 –Test2
Week 13 –Areas and distances, The definite integral, Evaluating definite integrals
Week 14 –The fundamental theorem of calculus, The substitution rule
Week 15 –Integration by parts, Trigonometric integrals and substitutions
Week 16 –Partial fractions, Integration with tables, Approximate integration
Week 17 –Improper integrals
Week 18 –Final exam

2.報告格式: 封面(A4紙；註記班級組別、姓名、學號 ) +三份心得報告；請用600字稿紙手寫寫滿， 不用刻意空行)
3.繳交期限: 111/1/14(五)中午12點前繳交系至辦，逾時不受理，亦不接受補交。
4.成績標準
缺席ㄧ次扣總成績2分，缺席兩次扣總成績4分，以此類推。
作業沒交ㄧ次扣總成績2分，作業沒交兩次扣總成績4分，以此類推。
請假ㄧ次扣總成績1分，請假兩次扣總成績2分，以此類推。
心得報告多一篇加1分，抄襲每篇扣1分(上課PPT照抄亦同)。
上課後一周內，心得海報經指導教授審閱修正後，電子檔傳給系辦許先生至大海報，若逾時視同作業遲交， 格式詳系網，請自行下載。
上課 5 分鐘後進教室，算遲到一次。 10鐘後進教室，算缺席一次；無故中途離席超過 10分鐘，算缺席一次，遲到亦會列入成績。
5.請假規則: (到系網列印填寫專討用請假單)
事假:務必於上課前填妥請假單並檢附(相關證明)，並請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。
病假:請於事後一周內填妥請假單，並檢附(就診證明)請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。
實體上課請依座位表點名，若代簽或無故缺課三次即以不及格處理，點名時不在座位上視同曠課論。
遠距上課亦同，上課請全程開鏡頭並且得在線上簽到代替點名，未開鏡頭者視同缺課。
6.期中、期末考週均不上課， 將不另行通知。
7.請隨時注意系走廊或系網頁公佈上課相關訊息。

description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生們一個可以改善他們的科技英文寫作技巧的環境，內容將包括：1. 扼要複習英文句型與文法，2. 撰寫論文常發生的錯誤，3. 分享論文審稿的經驗，4. 提供淺顯實用的寫作原則，5. 同儕分享讀論文與寫作的錯誤心得。
description.en: This course provides an environment to help students improving their English skill in writing technical paper or thesis. What will be included in the class are: 1. concise review of sentence structure and grammar, 2. frequent writing mistakes of paper or report, 3. share of the experience in paper review, 4. offering simple and practical writing principles, 5. share the experience in reading and writing papers.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to improve reading and writing skills. We will review the grammar, the articles, and the tense. After that, we will also discuss the common mistakes during writing. Then you will learn how to improve sentence fluency and how to structure an illustration paragraph. Gradually, you will learn how to write an essay. During the course, you will also read some articles from other journals to improve your reading skills.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的宗旨為協助科技專業的學生以英文寫作科技論文的能力。
寫作能力的基礎在閱讀，科技專業的學生越到高年級，使用英文教科書的比例越高，而閱讀原文教科書一向是國內大學生很吃力的工作，究其原因，不過是方法不當，大多還一直延用以前的逐字逐句翻譯的方式讀。
本課程帶領學生從字開始重新學英文，由字的「核心意思」而進入閱讀的方法，藉由正確的閱讀方法以建立信心，由此才能累積閱讀的經驗，也才能擺脫逐字逐句翻譯的惡夢，才得以進入英文思考的境界。
寫作是閱讀的反面，閱讀的方法運用熟練後，在以英文寫作時，才不會陷入寫一句，想一句的困境，也才能運用結構的觀念來將一個繁瑣的實驗過程，或是複雜的關係描述得清清楚楚。

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

name.zh: 鐵道電力供應與機電系統

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程，藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道電力供應系統的內涵。鐵道電力供應系統架構雖然類似一般配電系統，但其負載的列車位置與功率都是動態變化，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式，由具有實際經驗的本校教師、與鐵道電力業師共同授課，針對變電站、電車線與列車設備等三部分從最基本的設計分析、到保護協調與監控均予介紹。
description.en: This elective course is one of the Smart Railway Program. Both lectures in classroom and field trip to railway power system sites are given to learn the unique feature of dynamic loads in contrast to ordinary power distribution systems. The topics cover railway substations, overhead contact systems, and protection and coordination. Lecturers from the industry are invited to give students hand-on experience prepared for work for various railway systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程，藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道電力供應系統的內涵。鐵道電力供應系統架構雖然類似一般配電系統，但其負載的列車位置與功率都是動態變化，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式，由具有實際經驗的本校教師、與鐵道電力業師共同授課，針對變電站、電車線與列車設備等三部分從最基本的設計分析、到保護協調與監控均予介紹。本課程開放並鼓勵跨校選修，作為有志從事鐵道機電系統工作的本國學生就業準備的最後一哩路課程，不開放 外國籍學生修課。
This elective course is one of the Smart Railway Program. Both lectures in classroom and field trip to railway power system sites are given to learn the unique feature of dynamic loads in contrast to ordinary power distribution systems. The topics cover railway substations, overhead contact systems, and protection and coordination. Lecturers from the industry are invited to give students hand-on experience prepared for work for various railway systems. As such, this is the last-mile course designed to prepare students to work for the electrical and/or mechanical branches of rail operators in Taiwan. No foreign students are admitted to select this course.

syllabi.outline: Brushless dc and permanent-magnet synchronous motor have higher efficiency and energy to mass ratio in comparison to the other motors. They are gradually replacing induction motor and widely used in industry. This course begins with the theory of basic electromagnetic energy conversion, followed by the modeling and vector control theory for permanent-magnet synchronous motor, design and control of brushless dc motors, and the driving circuit design for these motors. Finally, sensorless PM machine control techniques are introduced.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。

description.en:
This course provides thefundamental theories and architectures for baseband wireless communications. It is concerned that how reliable communication can be achieved and what is the capacity a channel can provide. Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-inputmultiple-output (MIMO) transmission.
Course outline:
1.The Wireless Channel 
2.Diversity
3.Capacity of Wireless Channels
4.MIMO I: Spatial Multiplexing 
5.MIMO II: Capacity and Multiplexing Architectures
6.MIMO III: Diversity-Multiplexing Tradeoff
7.MIMO IV: Multiuser Communication

description.zh: 介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括(1)電機工程介紹，(2)電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3)電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4)交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5)暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6)交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。
description.en: Introduce to the principles of electrical, electronic, and electromechanical engineering. The context contains: (1) Introduction to electrical engineering, (2) Fundamentals of electric circuits: electric, current, voltage, power, and Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws, (3)Resistive network analysis: node analysis, mesh analysis, the principle of superposition, Thevenie and Norton equivalent circuits, (4)AC network analysis: energy storage circuit elements and the analysis of AC circuits excited by sinusoidal voltages and currents, (5)Transient analysis: describe the behavior of a voltage or a current between two distinct steady-state conditions, (6)AC power: simple AC power calculations and the generation and distribution of electric power.

syllabi.outline:
隨著材料科技的進步，材料的應用也逐步擴展到微精密電子元件、3C光電元件、生醫電子元件等範疇。因此在從事相關技術的發展前提下， 了解電子及電路的基本原理有助於強化與提升相關技術的應用與開發能力。
本課程介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括(1)電機工程介紹，(2)電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3)電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4)交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5)暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6)交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。

description.en: Plastic deformation processing is a metal processing method which based on plastic deformation to transform metal material into objective shape. This course includes the foundation of metal plastic deformation, the foundation of plastic dynamics, and the introduction of all kinds of plastic deformative processing methods. The recent technology development of plastic deformation processing is related to formation technique and suitable for alternatives to all kinds of plastic deformation materials.

description.zh: 從黑體輻射光譜，X-ray 光譜、氫原子光譜分析開始及光電效應等引入量子化的概念；進而推出物質與波動之二象性。經由波爾之半古典的氫原子模型，結合量子化的概念以解釋原子結構，並引入薛丁格方程式所求得之波函數與電子之空間機率的關係描述粒子波動特性，進而探討位能井與氫原子光譜模型。再由原子進而推廣至分子及固態物理之能帶理論，應用能帶理論於解釋固態晶體之光、電及熱學等特性，並介紹電子陶瓷材料之應用的基本原理。
description.en: From the analysis of the spectra of black-body radiation、X-Ray、Hydrogen atom and photoelectric effect, the concept of quantization is introduced and the duality of matter and wave is also introduced. Combining the idea of quantization and the semi-classical hydrogen model of Bohr, the structure of atom is described. Solving the Schrodinger equation, the deduced wave function is related to the probability of finding the electron in space, a particle in the potential well and in a box. The concept of atom is expanded to the molecular and the energy band theory of solid state physics. The energy band theory deduced from the modern physics is applied to account the optical, electrical and thermal properties of solid states, wherefore the fundamental principles and the applications of electro-ceramics are introduced.

description.zh: 本課程是大學部程度的巨量資料分析導論課程，主要介紹資料前處理、資料探勘概念、關聯分析、分類、分群、平行化程式設計、分散式計算、以及實際平台工具如: MapReduce, Spark等。除了基本概念的介紹外，透過程式練習以及期末專題，能讓學生深入理解巨量資料分析的基本原理以及實際工具的應用。
description.en: This undergraduate-level course offers an introduction to the concepts in big data analytics. Topics include data preprocessing, data mining, association rule, classification, clustering, parallel programming, distributed computing, MapReduce, and Spark. Programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the basic ideas and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

description.zh: 本課程透過原理解說與系統實作，使學生掌握社群媒體API介接技術，並能運用軟體工程方法，設計對話機器人(Conversational Bot)系統，應用於客服、零售、金融與製造等領域。課程內容包括下列模組：Line及WeChat社群訊息接口，對話訊息格式，Google Dialogflow及IBM Watson Assistant 對話流程開發平台，API流量與安全管理平台，GCP(Google Cloud Platform)及AWS(Amazon Web Service)雲端系統開發框架。藉由程式實作及期末專題設計，引導學生掌握人工智慧語意分析技術，整合後台知識庫與大數據，進而設計對話機器人應用系統。
description.en: This course provides students with the knowledge and skills to design intelligent conversational bot application systems using Line Messaging API and WeChat Open Platform.  Course spans a variety of technologies such as natural language understanding tools, Google Dialogflow, IBM Watson Assistant, API management framework, GCP (Google Cloud Platform) and AWS (Amazon Web Service) cloud platform services to design and manage conversation flows for intelligent customer service systems.  Programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the basic ideas and practical tools in intelligent conversational bot system design.

syllabi.outline:
《課程大綱》

社群媒體發達、行動通訊蓬勃發展的時代，《智能訊息匯流》技術更顯重要。在【社群媒體與對話機器人系統設計】課程中，我們帶你掌握社群媒體API介接技術，對話訊息格式，深入探討Google Dialogflow對話流程開發平台，GCP(Google Cloud Platform, GCP)雲端系統開發框架，API流量與安全管理平台，大數據與人工智慧等技術。藉由程式實作及期末專題設計，運用軟體工程方法，設計對話機器人(Conversational Bot)系統，應用於客服、零售、金融與製造等領域。

This course provides students with the knowledge and skills to design intelligent conversational bot application systems using Line Messaging API and WeChat Open Platform.  Course spans a variety of technologies such as natural language understanding tools, Google Dialogflow, IBM Watson Assistant, API management framework, GCP (Google Cloud Platform) and AWS (Amazon Web Service) cloud platform services to design and manage conversation flows for intelligent customer service systems.  Programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the basic ideas and practical tools in intelligent conversational bot system design.

name.en: Design and Analysis of Computer Algorithms

description.zh: 1. 數學基礎 1.1 函數成長率之漸近性質 1.2 遞迴關係之解 1.3 數學歸納法 2. 基本分析技巧 2.1 計算複雜度之上下限2.2 最差情況分析及平均情況分析 2.3 動態平均分析 3. 基本設計技巧 3.1 分擊法 3.2 貪婪法 3.3 動態規劃 3.4 隨機演算法 4. 計算複雜度 4.1 資訊理論證明法 4.2 對抗式證明法 4.3 問題之線性轉換 4.4 完全NP
description.en: 1. Mathematical background 1.1 Asymptotic growth rate of functions 1.2 Solving recurrence relations 1.3 Mathematical induction 2. Basic analysis techniques 2.1 Computational complexities -- lower bounds and upper bounds 2.2 Worst case analysis and average case analysis 2.3 Amortized analysis 3. Basic Design Paradigms 3.1 Divide and conquer 3.2 Greedy methods 3.3 Dynamic programming 3.4 Probabilistic algorithms 4. Computational Complexity 4.1 Information-theoretic arguments 4.2 Adversary arguments 4.3 Linear reduction of problems 4.4 NP-completeness

syllabi.outline: The course gives a broad introduction about the design and analysis of computer algorithms. General topics to be covered include: growth of functions, recurrences, sorting and order statistics, fundamental and advanced data structures, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness.
syllabi.schedule:
1. Introduction (0.5 week)
2. Asymptotic analysis (1.5 weeks)
3. Recurrence Relations (1 week)
4. Advanced Data Structures (2 weeks)
5. Average and worst analysis (1 weeks)
6. Lower Bounds (1 week)
7. Dynamic Programming (2 weeks)
8. Graph algorithms (1.5 weeks)
9. Search and Traversal Techniques (1.5 week)
10. NP-Completeness (2 weeks)
11. Approximation Algorithms (1 week)
12. New Trends in Algorithms (2 weeks)
(* 1 week for exams, including midterm and final)
syllabi.assessment:
Assignments (40%): 7-9 homework sets.
Midterm (25%)
Final exam (35%)

description.zh: 本課程介紹在數位影像處理領域中會使用到的基本觀念與技術. 數位影像處理有非常多重要的應用, 如: 影像內容改善, 工業檢測, 機器知覺等. 課程內容包括: 1.數位影像處理的基礎 2.影像的轉換 3.影像的加強 4.影像的復原 5.彩色影像的處理6.影像的壓縮 7.影像的分割與特徵抽取 8.影像的表達及描述 9.影像的辨認與解釋
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques used in the field of digital image processing (IP). Digital Image Processing has many important applications, for example, image contents improvement, industrial inspection, machine perception. The outline of this course is: 1.Digital image fundamentals 2.Image transforms 3.Image enhancement 4. Image restoration 5. Color image processing 6. Image compression 7. Image segmentation and feature detection 8. Representation and description 9. Recognition and interpretation.

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

syllabi.outline:
奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬)等，以及對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法如何應用到光電元件與生醫感測器元件做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與感測器相關之科技知識。
Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide. Their physical, chemical, optoelectronic and sensory properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

description.en: To cope with the coming of the aging society, issues about health, housing, mobility, communication, leisure and work for senior citizens are discussed in the class. description.zh: 21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
description.en:
The function of industrial design in the 21st  century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs. 
         	Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs.
The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

name.zh: 設計思考與計算思維專題
name.en: Special topics in design thinking and computational thinking

description.zh: 本課程探討以人為本的設計思考與以系統化為基礎的計算思維，如何用以問題解決、系統設計與人類行為理解，包括同理心觀察的人類學方法、創意發展的比喻與類比思考方法、邏輯思維方法、巨大複雜系統設計與評估的工程思維方法，以及複雜性、智能、心理、人類行為的理解的科學思維方法。
description.en: This course is to explore some special topics about the approaches of human-centered design thinking and system-based computational thinking to problem solving, systematic design, and understanding human behavior, including the methods of empathy observation, metaphor and analogy, logic, complex systems, artificial intelligence, and psychology.

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

description.zh:
本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。
本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。
本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en:
This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.
This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

description.zh: 本課程介紹有限元素分析法基本原理及其在各種工程問題上之應用。包含有限元素分析法之基本觀念，利用變分原理建立有限元素模式，形狀函數及等參數元素，一維問題：桿、桁架、樑及骨架等，二維問題：平面應力應變及板殼問題。三維問題：一般實體，有限元素分析之計算機程式處理，有限元素分析於動態問題之應用，相關有限元素分析套裝軟體簡介

description.zh: 本課程介紹西洋藝術之審美與欣賞。包含從古希臘時期到俄羅斯前衛主義之西方藝術作品賞析。以編年和主題式的編排，並特別強調藝術風格的源流與內容分析。使學生理解在不同的社會、文化、宗教和歷史背景之下，各個時期的藝術家，創作出的作品成就。
description.en: This course introduces the aesthetic and appreciation of Western art, which includes works in the ancient Greek period to the Russian avant-garde. To choreographers and thematic choreography, it would particular emphasis on techniques and content analysis, so that students could understand the different social, cultural, religious and historical background, and how the artists of all periods had created their works.

description.zh: 21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
description.en:
The function of industrial design in the 21st  century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs. 
         	Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs.
The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

syllabi.outline:
21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
The function of industrial design in the 21st  century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs. 
         	Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs.
The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

name.zh: 設計思考與計算思維專題
name.en: Special topics in design thinking and computational thinking

description.zh: 本課程探討以人為本的設計思考與以系統化為基礎的計算思維，如何用以問題解決、系統設計與人類行為理解，包括同理心觀察的人類學方法、創意發展的比喻與類比思考方法、邏輯思維方法、巨大複雜系統設計與評估的工程思維方法，以及複雜性、智能、心理、人類行為的理解的科學思維方法。
description.en: This course is to explore some special topics about the approaches of human-centered design thinking and system-based computational thinking to problem solving, systematic design, and understanding human behavior, including the methods of empathy observation, metaphor and analogy, logic, complex systems, artificial intelligence, and psychology.

description.zh: 速寫是最古老、最容易、最快速的溝通方式之一，也是充滿希望的設計師及藝術家必備的絕技。藉由大量的植物寫生，提昇觀察能力並把線條練活，進而建立起掌控「形」的基本信心。接下來的靜物寫生著重整體的構圖關係，利用黑白灰的構圖原理，著眼在傳其「神」而不是傳其「形」。將前階段的單線練習，改作分塊、分面的線群練習。再接下來是人物肖像寫生練習。到此，線條的特質、比例的嚴謹皆要掌控，肖像對象的性別、年齡、特徵以及由內在而外顯的神韻，是畫者所要表達的。
description.en:
Sketching is one of the oldest, easiest and quickest methods of communication 
and also one of the most important skills a hopeful designer and artist must master. 
The course begins with a lot of plants sketching that helps to enhance your observation and build up your confidence in mastering forms and shapes in order to make your sketches vivid. Next still life sketching focuses on the composition. You are encouraged to utilize the composition principle of black, white and gray, and emphasize more on the vividness than the form until you get rid of the habit of passive copying of the objects. Then you move from the previous linear sketching practice into facet sketching and then block sketching. At the end of the semester, you will practice human portrait sketching. Until now you should be able to handle not only the characteristics of the line and proportion, but also the gender, age, charm and expression of the model.

To choreographers and thematic choreography, it would particular emphasis on techniques and content analysis, so that students could understand the different social, cultural, religious and historical background, and how the artists of all periods had created their works.

syllabi.outline:
西洋藝術史涵蓋藝術的發展與演變、藝術家的事蹟與社會文化的關係，以及藝術如何反映各文化與時代特色。本課程介紹西洋藝術的發展與藝術風格的演變，藝術家的成就與貢獻，藝術作品的形式與內涵等等。從圖像、符號、描寫等要素，加上外在的社會時代與文化背景，探討作品的意義與表現意涵。本課程介紹西方藝術史發展中的相關知識，逐步探討為何某一件藝術作品會在某一個時代、某一個地區誕生?這個作品的風格樣式又如何影響著後世。
This course introduces the aesthetic and appreciation of Western art, which includes works in the ancient Greek period to the Russian avant-garde. To choreographers and thematic choreography, it would particular emphasis on techniques and content analysis, so that students could understand the different social, cultural, religious and historical background, and how the artists of all periods had created their works.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程在闡述化學工業中以環保出發的催化劑之原理與應用。內容包括催化劑之化學結構、反應性、製備、物性鑑定、反應動力學分析。由催化循環、反應機制、催化劑結構、動力學來說明催化反應之原理。除此，並著重於介紹各催化反應應用類型：催化反應在溶液中、酵素、沸石孔洞及重要之工業固相觸媒。
description.en: This course explores the principles and applications of catalysts for the environmentally benign chemical processes. Topics include the concepts in chemical structure and reactivity of catalyst, catalyst preparation, catalyst characterization, and micro kinetic analysis of catalytic processes. The principles are illustrated with catalytic cycles, reaction mechanisms, catalyst structures, and kinetics. Additionally, we emphasis on applications of catalysis in solution, enzymes, solid and surfaces, within the molecular-scale cages of zeolites and sieves, the most important industrial catalysts.

This course explores the principles and applications of catalysts for the environmentally benign chemical processes. Topics include the concepts in chemical structure and reactivity of catalyst, catalyst preparation, catalyst characterization, and micro kinetic analysis of catalytic processes. The principles are illustrated with catalytic cycles, reaction mechanisms, catalyst structures, and kinetics. Additionally, we emphasis on applications of catalysis in solution, enzymes, solid and surfaces, within the molecular-scale cages of zeolites and sieves, the most important industrial catalysts.

name.zh: 虛擬空間展示與設計研究
name.en: Virtual Space Display and Design Research

description.zh: 本課程通過理論介紹虛擬實境（Virtual Reality, VR）的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實踐操作，再透過專題設定進行內容創作，最終完成研究驗證的工作。課程目的是訓練學生在VR空間展示與設計研究端的流程，諸如3D環境設計、VR空間與內容建構、VR內容輸出與展示等能力。最終，學生可基於這些能力應用於各種虛擬空間的展示設計。
description.en: In this course, I will introduce the concept and scope of application of Virtual Reality (VR) via the theory, and then introduce the method of 3D environment construction into practical operation. Furthermore, this course will be showed how to creates content through a thematic setting, and finally completes the work of research and verification. The purpose of the course is to train students in the process of VR space display and design research, such as 3D environment design, VR space and content construction, VR content output, and display capabilities. Finally, students can apply these abilities to the display design of various virtual spaces.

syllabi.outline:
本課程通過理論介紹虛擬實境（Virtual Reality, VR）的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實踐操作，再透過專題設定進行內容創作，最終完成研究驗證的工作。課程目的是訓練學生在VR空間展示與設計研究端的流程，諸如3D環境設計、VR空間與內容建構、VR內容輸出與展示等能力。最終，學生可基於這些能力應用於各種虛擬空間的展示設計。
In this course, I will introduce the concept and scope of application of Virtual Reality (VR) via the theory, and then introduce the method of 3D environment construction into practical operation. Furthermore, this course will be showed how to creates content through a thematic setting, and finally completes the work of research and verification. The purpose of the course is to train students in the process of VR space display and design research, such as 3D environment design, VR space and content construction, VR content output, and display capabilities. description.zh: 為應因八十七年之放流水標準,廢水處理必將進入高級處理之階段.在本課程中將深入探討混凝與膠凝,沈凝,氨氣提,過慮,吸附,薄膜處理,離子交換等各單元,並說明如何應用於廢水處理.
description.en: This topic is going to introduce Coagulation and Flocfulation,Sedimentation,Ammonia Removal,Filtration,Adsorption,and on exchange,and let learner know to use each unit on the wastewater treatment.

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

syllabi.outline: To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most important tools for analyzing and assessing environmental problems will be taught during the course of the semester. Students will also be learning a popular LCA software, SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as carbon footprinting and labeling, and eco-design will also be practiced in the class.

1. Introduction to Life Cycle and Systems Thinking and Life Cycle Management
2. Introduction to LCA, including ISO 14040 series and SimaPro Software)

6. LCA Methodology: Life Cycle Impact Assessment

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

syllabi.outline: Knowing the principle and development of each renewable energy, including solar energy, wind energy, ocean energy (wave energy, tide energy, ocean thermal energy, ocean salinity gradient energy), hydro energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and fuel cell. Realizing their potential, impact on the environment, and future perspective.

description.en: The course introduces monitoring and analysis for environment pollutants. It focuses the micro quantity analysis based on chemical theory. Modern instruments with high sensitivity will be also discussed.

name.en: Planning and Management for Air Quality

description.zh: 以都會區空氣品質為範圍，配合污染源類別﹙粒狀物，SOx， NOx， VOC， THC及O3﹚，本課程從逸散性、固定污染性、移動污染性等不同方向，以講述空品之規劃與管理等問題。此包括PSI指標與空品特性分析，及減目標與管制策略之研訂等。
description.en: The course gives a brief introduction to planning and management for air quality. The main contents are focused on fugitive pollution, stationary, and movable sources. Index of pollution standard will be also discussed in the course.

由於近年來人工智慧與大數據應用的蓬勃發展，新興的Python程式語言成為全世界學習程式語言的首要標的。相較於編譯式(compiled language)程式語言（例如，C/C++/Java），Python程式語言是一種完全開源費且程式語法具備可讀、簡潔及直觀特性的直譯式(interpreted language)程式語言。本課程教學在於Python程式設計基礎學習及其物件導向程式(Object-Oriented Programming, OOP)撰寫教學。經由本課程教學，同學對於未來使用Python至各個工程應用領域將會有相當大的助益。

description.zh: 本課程探討的主題是以設計管理的角度，探討如何經營設計品牌與應用網路媒體以協助產品的廣告與行銷目的，進而增加曝光與產品銷售的機會。課程內容包含：電子商務的定義與架構、產品品牌定義與設計、產品照片攝影、產品影片拍攝、頻道經營與直播、線上募資活動等。課程中除了理論與技術教學，也會輔以案例研討方式，加強學生理解，以達到最佳的學習效果。
description.en: In this course, we discussed how to manage design brands and online media application to assist product advertising and marketing purposes from the perspective of design management, thereby increasing the product exposure and sales opportunities. The course content includes definition and structure of e-commerce, product brand definition and design, product photo photography, product video creation, channel management and live broadcast, online fundraising activities, etc. In addition to theoretical and technical teaching, the course will also be supplemented by case studies to strengthen students' understanding and achieve the best learning effect.

description.zh: 地質災害調查分析課程將介紹地震、山崩、滑坡、地破、地縫等災害的發生原因及其調查分析方法，包括地質調查、工程地質勘查、地球物理探測和遙感技術等方面。課程內容還包括地質災害預防與治理方法等方面。
description.en: This course will introduce the causes and investigation and analysis methods of geological disasters such as earthquakes, landslides, rockfalls, ground fissures, and soil subsidence. It includes geological survey, engineering geological exploration, geophysical exploration, and remote sensing technology. The course also covers prevention and control methods of geological hazards.

syllabi.outline: Geological hazard is one of the main types of natural disasters, and historically it has brought endless pain to humans, leaving many painful memories, so it is the environmental issues that are of the most concern to people. This class is highly recommended for the following reasons: (1) understandable explanations of complex geologic processes are provided in clear diagrams, (2)world-wide examples are used, (3) modern interdisciplinary approaches are emphasized, (4) a robust bibliography is provided.

syllabi.outline: This course focus on investigating the strength and deformability of jointed rock mass from analyzing the mechanical behavior of intact rock and discontinuities. description.zh:
深度學習數位影像分析，在近代的製造、醫藥、農業、太空探索、運輸和通信系統等應用領域，正迅速發展中。本課程主要介紹深度學習數位影像分析基本理論基礎，以此概念實際應用到各領域中。課程將探索最先進的深度學習模型，如物件偵測、影像分類，和影像分割，提供實用的實務練習；最後討論數位影像分析深度學習的未來挑戰。課程也將介紹最新的公開影像數據集(例如MNIST，CIFAR-10和ImageNet)，並涵蓋用於深度學習中的影像數據前處理和樣本標籤註記，詳細探討深度學習模型的評估指標。本課程將使用Matlab和Python範例，實作教學練習，課程單元包含:

description.en:
This course covers the basics of deep learning for digital image analysis, including theoretical concepts and practical applications. Students will learn about object detection, image classification, and segmentation using state-of-the-art deep learning models. The course will also address the challenges of using deep learning in digital image analysis and cover popular image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. Additionally, students will gain hands-on experience in image data preparation and labeling, and learn about evaluation metrics for deep learning models. Programming examples will be provided in Python or Matlab. The course includes:
●A gentle introduction to digital image analysis and deep learning.
●Convolutional neural networks.
●Transfer learning.
●Image data labeling for deep learning.
●Evaluating deep learning models.
●The challenges of deep learning in the field of digital image analysis.
●Activation functions.
●Loss functions.
●Optimizers.

syllabi.outline:
The field of digital image analysis is growing rapidly in many application areas such as manufacturing, medicine, agriculture, transportation, and communication systems. This course aims to introduce the foundations of deep learning for digital image analysis from the fundamental theoretical concepts to applications. The class will provide students with an opportunity to explore the state-of-the-art deep learning models for object detection, image classification, and image segmentation with practical hands-on experience. The challenges of deep learning in the field of digital image analysis will be discussed in this class. The course will also explore some popular image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet, covering the image data preparation and labeling for deep learning. Evaluation metrics for deep learning models will be examined in detail. Students are free to use any programming language, however the programming examples in this course will be given in Matlab and Python.

description.zh: 本課程為整合型課程，以多主題方式介紹當代與下世代先進材料化學技術，包含先進奈米合成技術、奈米微影科技、功能性催化材料化學、生醫材料化學、功能性高分子設計以及軟性元件製作等。本課程為跨系院課程，由多位教師共同授課，提供跨領域知識學習與培養學生跨領域思考。
description.en: This course is an integrated course that introduces emerging and next-generation advanced materials chemistry in a multi-topic approach, including advanced nanomaterials synthesis, nanolithography technology, catalytic materials chemistry, biomaterials chemistry, functional polymer design, and the production of soft electronic devices. It is an interdepartmental course, lectured by multiple teachers, and providing multidisciplinary knowledge learning.

description.zh: 本課程藉由實地場域踏場及在地對話，導入設計思考與實踐能量，學習如何協助地方擴展並升級形象。課程中可藉由形象設計等手法了解如何提升城市文化的在地體驗，深化地方共同體的歸屬感。修課學生可實際體驗形象塑造之程序及手法，包含參與線上線下設計工作坊、試打樣與製作之程序，可串接未來展示與社造等設計研究相關活動。
description.en: This course introduces design thinking and practical energy through field visits and in-situ dialogues and learns how to help expand and upgrade the image of a place. In this course, I will teach image design and other design methods to understand how to enhance urban culture's in-place experience and deepen the local community's sense of belonging. Students can experience image-building procedures and techniques, including participating in online and offline design workshops, trial proofing and production procedures, and connecting with future exhibition and social design research-related activities.

description.zh: 本課程藉由實地場域踏場及在地對話，導入設計思考與實踐能量，學習如何協助地方擴展並升級形象。課程中可藉由形象設計等手法了解如何提升城市文化的在地體驗，深化地方共同體的歸屬感。修課學生可實際體驗形象塑造之程序及手法，包含參與線上線下設計工作坊、試打樣與製作之程序，可串接未來展示與社造等設計研究相關活動。
description.en: This course introduces design thinking and practical energy through field visits and in-situ dialogues and learns how to help expand and upgrade the image of a place. In this course, I will teach image design and other design methods to understand how to enhance urban culture's in-place experience and deepen the local community's sense of belonging. Students can experience image-building procedures and techniques, including participating in online and offline design workshops, trial proofing and production procedures, and connecting with future exhibition and social design research-related activities.

description.zh: 本課程以論文研討方式學習 "機器學習" 理論之基本概念與應用及各種演算法。課程內容包含概念式學習、決策樹、圖型理論、神經網路、貝氏網路、案例式學習及支持向量機等方法。經由這門課，學生能對現代機器學習技術及其應用有基本的了解。
description.en: This is a graduate seminar-based course that provides an overview of many algorithms in machine learning and its applications. In this course, we will take an interdisciplinary look at current research topics in machine learning covering Concept Learning, Decision Tree, Graphical Model, Neural Network, Bayesian Network, Instance-based Learning, and Support Vector Machine. Through the course, students can have the basic ideas and intuition behind modern machine learning methods.

syllabi.outline:
使學員瞭解Python程式語言於機器學習應用，以及機器學習的理論背景、評估如何使用適當的演算法於實際例子、內容包括回歸分析於資料預測、資料維度減少方法於資料特徵提取、資料分類方法包括支援向量機與類神經網路方法。課程主要配合Python例子增進學員了解機器學習的相關知識與提升在資訊處理時代之競爭力。

To enable students to understand the Python programming language for machine learning and the theoretical background of machine learning. Students are able to assess how to use appropriate algorithms in practical examples, including regression analysis, dimension reduction, feature extraction, classification methods, support vector machines, and neural networks. The course uses Python examples to improve students' knowledge of machine learning.

description.zh: 地質工程為一新興科學，原來為解決全球變遷等大尺度問題而提出。基本上可以土木及環境工程兩大方面。本課程將從地質背景出發，結合工程問題及其處理對策，提供學生一個整合性的思考及基礎的地質知能。
description.en: Geoengineering is planetary-scale environmental engineering, particularly engineering aimed at counteracting the undesired side effects of other human activities. Geoengineering covers a wide range of engineering disciplines related to geo-materials, such as foundation engineering, slope engineering, tunnelling, rock engineering, engineering geology and geo-environmental engineering. This course interests range from geological to geomorphological concept, to provide a firm fundamental background for the civil engineering and environmental engineering, and to manage and mitigate of natural hazards. Implicit in these pursuits is the stewardship of the earth, and the quest to harvest the most advanced fruits of scientific achievements as tools for our graduates to work with.

Some topics about object-oriented programming language and system analysis are also addressed after students familiar with the programming language.

syllabi.outline: 本課程之目標為使學生了解營建工程之可能污染方式與其防治方法與防治原理，課程內容將先概述台灣地區營建汙染相關法規，其次將對噪音與震動汙染，空氣汙染(逸散性粒狀物)，廢棄物污染，水汙染等分項概述。於該等分項概述中，將於適當之時機提及該等汙染對現場人員所可能造成之傷害，並概述防治方法。最後本課程將概述最新的綠營建概念，以從根本減低廢棄物的量。本課程除了講授台灣地區之相關法規之外，並將簡介美國之相關實務經驗，以俾利國內相關產業與國際標準接軌。

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

syllabi.outline: 隨著台灣農工社會、經濟型態的轉變以及對水資源安全供應之要求日益增加情況下，地下水與地表水聯合運用成為整體水資源經營管理不可或缺之一環。而超抽地下水造成之各項災害也與氣候變遷下複合型災害相連結。對地下水文進行更深入之探討，將裨益於解決各項地下水資源應用與防災相關問題。地下水的領域涵蓋水量,水質及防災三方面,修習此一學科，可以了解地下水水文及水力學之基本原理，進而掌握地下水水理與污染傳輸之特性,以作為規劃與管理地下水資源及防災之依據。

name.zh: 鐵道號誌與行車控制系統
name.en: Railway Signal and Traffic Control System

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道號誌系統的內涵。號誌系統是列車運行的控制系統。其功用必需兼顧整個鐵道運輸系統的「安全」、「迅速」、與「經濟」。由於號誌系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與控制等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道號誌系統專家、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊與自動控制等三部分提出號誌系統規劃與評估報告，並邀請鐵道號誌系統專家擔任評審。
description.en: This course is one of the optional courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The goal of this course is, via both in-class lecturing and field-trip visiting, to have participant students realize the contents of Railway Signal System. The signal system is the control system of train operation. To give consideration to safety, rapidness and economy of entire railway transportation system, this system will be required. Since the signal system is the technology including management, communication and automatic control, this course is a joint-lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors for the participant students include experts on railway signal system from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In the student reports, they will demonstrate the railway signal system planning and evaluation report for the management, communication and automatic control.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要的課程目標是希望能夠加強學生在作業管理方面的知識。課程內容主要涵蓋了策略議題與實務應用兩部分，包括預測、產品與服務的設計、產能規劃、品質管理、供應鏈管理、存貨管理與排程等議題。作業管理相關領域的觀念、工具及應用，對從事與製造業相關工作的人來說，乃必備知識。因此，對主修機械的同學來說，瞭解作業管理相關領域的觀念、工具及應用，是相當重要的。由於本課程與機械系一般技術課程，在觀念上有很大的不同，所以建議同學在課餘時間可以多看看報紙、雜誌及電視上，有關製造業經營管理與產業發展的報導。
The main goal of this course is to strengthen students' knowledge of homework management. The course content mainly covers two parts: strategic issues and practical applications, including forecasting, product and service design, capacity planning, quality management, supply chain management, inventory management and scheduling. The concepts, tools, and applications in the field of job management are essential knowledge for those engaged in manufacturing-related jobs. Therefore, it is very important for students majoring in mechanics to understand the concepts, tools and applications in the related fields of homework management. Since this course is very different in concept from the general technical courses in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, it is recommended that students should read more newspapers, magazines and TV reports on manufacturing management and industrial development in their spare time.

description.zh: 本課程以機械製造結合工業4.0技術為主，包括近代製造技術概論、E化製造、物聯網基本介紹、巨量資料於製程優化的應用、智慧型演算之原理與應用、機器視覺檢測應用、彈性製造系統、網宇實體系統、智能化工廠應用實例、應用APP撰寫等，增進學生對現代製造技術內容之理解、內化、與判斷應用能力，並加強工業4.0相關最新科技之介紹與應用，以期培養對應用聯網技術、大數據、雲端運算、及人工智慧於製造相關課題有技術與能力之工程師。
description.en: This course is based on integration of mechanical manufacturing and industry 4.0, which is made of the modern manufacturing, the computational manufacturing,the internet of things, the optimization of manufacturing using big data, the intelligent calculation, machine vision measurement, flexible manufacturing, CPS system, smart factory, APP, etc.. This course can improve student’s knowledge of modern manufacturing, judgment, and industry 4.0, which will further create engineers with networking technology, big data, cloud calculation, and artificial intelligence in manufacturing.

description.en: The course introduces the structure of a electron microscope, the theories of image forming and diffraction, the applications of materials science. name.zh: 植入物與矯具生物力學

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
生物力學是一門整合醫學與工學的學科。本課程介紹並討論十大主題：(1)脊椎生物力學、(2)關節生物力學、(3)骨折生物力學、(4)復健生物力學、(5)運動生物力學、(6)心血管生物力學、(7)植入物設計原理、(8)手術器械設計原理、(9)矯具設計原理與(10)病床與輪椅設計原理。
description.en: Biomechanics is a multi-discipline branch incorporating medicine and mechanics. Ten topics are introduced and discussed in this class: (1) spinal biomechanics, (2) joint biomechanics, (3) trauma biomechanics, (4) rehabilitation biomechanics, (5) sport biomechanics, (6) cardiovascular biomechanics, (7) implant design, (8) instrument design, (9) orthotice design, and (10) sickbed and wheelchair design.

syllabi.outline:
生物力學是一門整合生物醫學與力學的學科。本課程涵蓋生物力學基礎概念與理論之介紹，並分別討論以下各主題：(1)生物力學概論、(2)植入物與矯具、(3) 骨骼生物力學、(4) 髖關節生物力學、(5) 膝關節生物力學、(6)足部生物力學、(7) 脊椎生物力學、(8) 牙科生物力學、(9) 人體動作分析、(10)電腦輔助工程分析在生物力學之應用。各主題中亦將介紹各式植入物與輔具於臨床醫學上之應用。

Biomechanics is a multi-disciplinary science which integrates biomedical and mechanical subjects. This course covers the basic principles of biomechanics and its applications in the following topics: (1) Introduction to biomechanics; (2) Prosthetics and orthotics; (3) Bone mechanics; (4) Hip joint biomechanics; (5) Knee joint biomechanics; (6) Biomechanics of foot and footwear; (7) Spine biomechanics; (8) Dental biomechanics; (9) Human motion analysis; (10) Applications of CAE in biomechanics. The related prothetic and orthotic devices will also be introduced in selected topics.

description.zh: 資料庫是任何完整的資訊管理系統之不可或缺的一部份，並且已經在各行各業中顯示其與日俱增的重要性，當然土木工程也不例外。尤其近年來地理資訊系統、營建管理系統及地質鑽孔資料庫的發展，更促使土木工程師正視資料庫的重要性，並學習如何有效地管理龐大的相關資訊。因此，本課程的設計即針對此需要來教導學生熟悉現代資料庫系統的設計與技術，以使他們在畢業後更具有競爭力，更容易找到理想的工作。課程的內容將包括資料處理、概念設計、關連式資料模型、及正規化等領域，而學生必須在學期中設計並完成一個完整的資料庫作為專題計畫。關於本課程的其他細節請見下述課程大綱。
description.en: Database（DB） is an integral part of any information management system, and has been playing a significant role in many academic programs and professions, including the civil engineering, construction engineering, and environmental engineering. In recent years, the development of Geographical Information System, Construction Decision Support System, and Geotechnical Data Bank all require practicing civil engineers to understand the principles of underlying data storage and to develop an effective style of data management to achieve competitiveness in the market place. Therefore, it is the focus of this course to guide the students to become familiar with various technical aspects of modern DB systems so that they can perform the above-mentioned tasks and become more employable. This course will cover areas such as data processing, conceptual DB design, relational data model, and normalization. The students are required to complete a semester project and implement a functional DB.

description.zh: 本課程教授商品化實務概念並由學生實際操作，如何以一貫作業完成市場銷售商品。由消費者洞察開始，教導學生如何從消費者行為找到需求，進而思考產品設計動機。設計過程中涵蓋專利，製造與營運思維，最後以實際商品設計呈現。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is study the concept of commercialization and how to sale the products to marketing through the consistent process.
It’ll ask student to find the consumer's requirements from observation, then think and confirm the design purpose. The design process will include patent, manufacture, operating thinking, and commodity design.

syllabi.outline: 課程涵蓋網路與通訊的基礎和最新發展。內容包括:機率和排隊系統；行動無線傳播；通道編碼與錯誤控制(WiFi的FCS，LTE/4G的turbo code/ARQ+CRC)；細胞式概念(為何基地台要很多個)；MAC層協定(WiFi的CSMA/CA，乙太網路的CSMA/CD)；FDMA/TDMA/CDMA/OFDM(1-4G的主要技術)；通道分配(有限頻譜/功率資源如何分配給各基地台)。
syllabi.schedule:
1.	Introduction
2.	Probability, Statistics, and Traffic Theories
3.	Mobile Radio Propagation
4.	Channel Coding and Error Control (FCS in WiFi, turbo codes/ARQ+CRC in LTE/4G)
5.	Cellular Concept

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養設計與實作軟體定義無線網路的能力。軟體定義網路由控制平面、資料平面與網路功能虛擬化等技術所構成，透過資料平面/控制平面設計，以軟體定義封包傳輸方式。本課程著重於這些軟體定義網路的技術於無線網路的設計，包含應用軟體定義網路在物聯網及 5G 通訊系統。本課程以實習方式利用 OpenFlow 實作控制器及交換器，使學生透過資料平面與控制平面技術的開發，瞭解軟體定義網路對於無線網路的影響。

description.zh:
生物工程和醫療技術的研究和發展，在最近幾十年中，促成明確的臨床醫學和衛生保健的進步。這些領域的發展，開啟了生物工程、臨床技術和醫學信息領域課程的蓬勃發展；目前，各大學及研究所多有提供這些領域的課程。然而，大多數參與者多來自工程背景，因此學習生物科學和醫學應用於工程思維及模式，方能使得工程師和醫生之間的科學能無礙地交流。
這項課程主要是為了使主修工程及材料的學生提供具有實用性的人體結構和組織的原則及相互依存的細胞和組織器官的生理系統進行有用的學習。雖然課程可能無法全然覆蓋所有生物醫學工程領域的基礎，但在這個學習過程中，我們將專注於大多數生物醫學工程以及生技和組織工程從事的主要研發領域作出努力。這門課程是醫學和工程及材料之間的橋樑。這將是促進各類工程及設計師和醫事人員之間文化和科學的交通和相互研習課程，促進生物醫學工程的創新發現和發展。在這個過程中，我們將提供一系列的生物學和醫學知識和方法，應用在工程、材料和電子領域，旨在幫助他們能將其整和連接，可以開始從工程進入生物醫學工程的專業，或者提供工程師期許能“簡單”理解特定臨床醫療科學和技術。經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，將結合工程及材料師長的經
